lines.gurmukhi: ਉਪਜੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aupajee preet prem ras chaau ||
lines.translation: Love and affection, and the taste of yearning, have welled up within;

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਇਹੀ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan a(n)tar ihee suaau ||
lines.translation: within my mind and body, this is my purpose:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੇਤ੍ਰਹੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: netrahu pekh dharas sukh hoi ||
lines.translation: beholding with my eyes His Blessed Vision, I am at peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਨ ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man bigasai saadh charan dhoi ||
lines.translation: My mind blossoms forth in ecstasy, washing the feet of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat janaa kai man tan ra(n)g ||
lines.translation: The minds and bodies of His devotees are infused with His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: biralaa kouoo paavai sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: Rare is the one who obtains their company.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਬਸਤੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek basat dheejai kar miaa ||
lines.translation: Show Your mercy - please, grant me this one request:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaadh naam jap liaa ||
lines.translation: by Guru's Grace, may I chant the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kee upamaa kahee na jai ||
lines.translation: His Praises cannot be spoken;

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak rahiaa sarab samai ||6||
lines.translation: O Nanak, He is contained among all. ||6||

structure: The shabad names love and yearning as the true movement inside the devotee.
From there it praises the company of the holy, where the mind blossoms and devotion deepens.
It finally asks for the one essential gift, Naam, and sees the Lord pervading all.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad begins with love rising inside the mind and body as a real hunger for darshan and holy company. It asks for one mercy only, the grace to chant Naam, and ends by widening the heart into the Lord's presence everywhere.

evidence.practicalImplication: This one speaks to the person who feels unworthy, guarded, or tired of being hard on themselves. Kept close, it makes yearning honest again and shows that mercy often arrives through saintly company and the simple grace to remember. Ask for the grace to remember, and let love soften the guarded heart.

title: Love the Guru with mind and body
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 52
summary: The shabad starts by fastening mind and body to the Guru in love. It broadens through obedience, Sangat, and the dust-like poverty of Maya-attachment, then ends in total remembrance: this life, body, and breath are Yours.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person whose love has been scattered across comforts, approval, and restless seeking. Kept close, it gathers desire back to one center and turns company, conduct, and remembrance into a single path.
takeaway: Let love, company, and conduct gather under the Guru until forgetfulness weakens.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur paramesur poojeeaai man tan lai piaar ||
lines.translation: Worship the Guru, the Transcendent Lord, with your mind and body attuned to love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur dhaataa jeea kaa sabhasai dhei adhaar ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the Giver of the soul; He gives Support to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਸਚਾ ਏਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bachan kamaavane sachaa eh veechaar ||
lines.translation: Act according to the Instructions of the True Guru; this is the true philosophy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bin saadhoo sa(n)gat ratiaa maiaa moh sabh chhaar ||1||
lines.translation: Without being attuned to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all attachment to Maya is just dust. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere saajan har har naam samaal ||
lines.translation: O my friend, reflect upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)gat man vasai pooran hovai ghaal ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: . In the Saadh Sangat, He dwells within the mind, and one's works are brought to perfect fruition. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur samarath apaar gur vaddabhaagee dharasan hoi ||
lines.translation: The Guru is All-powerful, the Guru is Infinite. By great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur agochar niramalaa gur jevadd avar na koi ||
lines.translation: The Guru is Imperceptible, Immaculate and Pure. There is no other as great as the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur karataa gur karanahaar gurmukh sachee soi ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Creator, the Guru is the Doer. The Gurmukh obtains true glory.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur te baahar kichh nahee gur keetaa loRe su hoi ||2||
lines.translation: Nothing is beyond the Guru; whatever He wishes comes to pass. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur teerath gur paarajaat gur manasaa pooranahaar ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Sacred Shrine of Pilgrimage, the Guru is the Wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur dhaataa har naam dhei udharai sabh sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Fulfiller of the desires of the mind. The Guru is the Giver of the Name of the Lord, by which all the world is saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur samarath gur nira(n)kaar gur uoochaa agam apaar ||
lines.translation: The Guru is All-powerful, the Guru is Formless; the Guru is Lofty, Inaccessible and Infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੇ ਕਥਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee mahimaa agam hai kiaa kathe kathanahaar ||3||
lines.translation: The Praise of the Guru is so sublime-what can any speaker say? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੜੇ ਫਲ ਮਨਿ ਬਾਛੀਅਹਿ ਤਿਤੜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jitaRe fal man baachhe'eeh titaRe satigur paas ||
lines.translation: All the rewards which the mind desires are with the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਪਾਵਣੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorab likhe paavane saach naam dhe raas ||
lines.translation: One whose destiny is so pre-ordained, obtains the Wealth of the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆਂ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur saranee aaiaa(n) baahuR nahee binaas ||
lines.translation: Entering the Sanctuary of the True Guru, you shall never die again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੯੯॥
lines.transliteration: har naanak kadhe na visarau eh jeeau pi(n)dd teraa saas ||4||29||99||
lines.translation: Nanak: may I never forget You, Lord. This soul, body and breath are Yours. ||4||29||99||

structure: The shabad begins by calling for whole-hearted love of the Guru, not partial admiration.
From there it shows how that love becomes lived: act on the Guru's word, stay in Sangat, and let Maya lose its glamour.
The closing movement rests in surrender so full that soul, body, and breath are handed back to the Lord.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad starts by fastening mind and body to the Guru in love. It broadens through obedience, Sangat, and the dust-like poverty of Maya-attachment, then ends in total remembrance: this life, body, and breath are Yours.
evidence.turn: From there it shows how that love becomes lived: act on the Guru's word, stay in Sangat, and let Maya lose its glamour.
evidence.practicalImplication: This one meets the person whose love has been scattered across comforts, approval, and restless seeking. Kept close, it gathers desire back to one center and turns company, conduct, and remembrance into a single path. Let love, company, and conduct gather under the Guru until forgetfulness weakens.

title: Love the true treasure before desire names your wealth
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 256
summary: The pauree opens by commanding love for the Lord as the true treasure. It answers desire, fear, and the fantasy of lasting wealth by saying the Name alone accompanies and enlightens.
whyItMatters: This shabad speaks to the part of us that is driven by craving, acquisition, or the fear of losing it all. Kept close, it cools desire by showing what does and does not travel with you.
takeaway: Keep this in front of you: love the true treasure before desire names your wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤਾ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tataa taa siau preet kar gun nidh gobidh rai ||
lines.translation: TATTA: Embrace love for the Treasure of Excellence, the Sovereign Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਬਾਛਤੇ ਤਪਤਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: fal paaveh man baachhate tapat tuhaaree jai ||
lines.translation: You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires, and your burning thirst shall be quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੈ ਜਮ ਪੰਥ ਕੀ ਜਾਸੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: traas miTai jam pa(n)th kee jaas basai man naau ||
lines.translation: One whose heart is filled with the Name shall have no fear on the path of death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਠਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gat paaveh mat hoi pragaas mahalee paaveh Thaau ||
lines.translation: He shall obtain salvation, and his intellect shall be enlightened; he will find his place in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਧਨੁ ਚਲੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜੋਬਨ ਨਹ ਰਾਜ ॥
lines.transliteration: taahoo sa(n)g na dhan chalai gireh joban neh raaj ||
lines.translation: Neither wealth, nor household, nor youth, nor power shall go along with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਹੁ ਇਹੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਕਾਜ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g simarat rahahu ihai tuhaarai kaaj ||
lines.translation: In the Society of the Saints, meditate in remembrance on the Lord. This alone shall be of use to you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਤਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਜਉ ਤਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਆਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: taataa kachhoo na hoiee hai jau taap nivaarai aap ||
lines.translation: There will be no burning at all, when He Himself takes away your fever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮਹਿ ਆਪਹਿ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: pratipaalai naanak hameh aapeh maiee baap ||32||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself cherishes us; He is our Mother and Father. ||32||

structure: The shabad begins by naming the Lord as the real treasure worth loving.
From there it speaks to thirst, fear, and liberation through a heart filled with the Name.
The closing movement rests by stripping wealth, youth, and power of their claim to permanence.

evidence.coreClaim: The pauree opens by commanding love for the Lord as the true treasure. It answers desire, fear, and the fantasy of lasting wealth by saying the Name alone accompanies and enlightens.
evidence.turn: From there it speaks to thirst, fear, and liberation through a heart filled with the Name.
evidence.practicalImplication: This shabad speaks to the part of us that is driven by craving, acquisition, or the fear of losing it all. Kept close, it cools desire by showing what does and does not travel with you. Keep this in front of you: love the true treasure before desire names your wealth.

title: Make Naam the work of your life
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 290
summary: The shabad begins by giving the saints a clear assignment — let Naam be the real work. It presses past distraction, calling for remembrance, shared encouragement, and the peace that even the drowning can find in the treasure of the Name.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person who is searching hard, exhausted, and still unconvinced that rest is possible. Taken seriously, it gathers scattered effort into one practice and turns private seeking into a shared, living discipline.
takeaway: Let Naam become the work that orders everything else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saajan sa(n)t karahu ih kaam ||
lines.translation: O friends, O Saints, make this your work.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aan tiaag japahu har naam ||
lines.translation: Renounce everything else, and chant the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: simar simar simar sukh paavahu ||
lines.translation: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਅਵਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap japahu avareh naam japaavahu ||
lines.translation: Chant the Naam yourself, and inspire others to chant it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਤਰੀਐ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat bhai tareeaai sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: By loving devotional worship, you shall cross over the world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin bhagatee tan hosee chhaar ||
lines.translation: Without devotional meditation, the body will be just ashes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੂਖ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab kaliaan sookh nidh naam ||
lines.translation: All joys and comforts are in the treasure of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਜਾਤ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: booddat jaat paae bisraam ||
lines.translation: Even the drowning can reach the place of rest and safety.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਦੂਖ ਕਾ ਹੋਵਤ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal dhookh kaa hovat naas ||
lines.translation: All sorrows shall vanish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਨਤਾਸੁ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam japahu gunataas ||5||
lines.translation: O Nanak, chant the Naam, the treasure of excellence. ||5||

structure: The shabad names the central task without hesitation: chant the Lord's Name.
From there it says to practice it personally and help others into the same remembrance.
It finally promises rest, joy, and the ending of sorrow in the treasure of Naam.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad begins by giving the saints a clear assignment — let Naam be the real work. It presses past distraction, calling for remembrance, shared encouragement, and the peace that even the drowning can find in the treasure of the Name.
evidence.turn: From there it says to practice it personally and help others into the same remembrance.
evidence.practicalImplication: This one meets the person who is searching hard, exhausted, and still unconvinced that rest is possible. Taken seriously, it gathers scattered effort into one practice and turns private seeking into a shared, living discipline. Let Naam become the work that orders everything else.

title: Make the body honorable by what it serves
subtitle: Raag Maajh · Ang 103
summary: The shabad begins by blessing words that speak Naam, then blesses eyes, hands, and feet when they turn toward praise, darshan, and the Lord's path. It closes with a prayer that even a sinking stone be lifted by mercy.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person whose body is busy all day without much of it turning toward God. Held carefully, it makes ordinary faculties answerable to praise and holy company.
takeaway: Let speech, sight, hands, and feet become honorable through praise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: safal su baanee jit naam vakhaanee ||
lines.translation: Blessed are those words, by which the Naam is chanted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadh kinai viralai jaanee ||
lines.translation: Rare are those who know this, by Guru's Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਆਏ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)nu su velaa jit har gaavat sunanaa aae te paravaanaa jeeau ||1||
lines.translation: Blessed is that time when one sings and hears the Lord's Name. Blessed and approved is the coming of such a one. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: se netr paravaan jinee dharasan pekhaa ||
lines.translation: Those eyes which behold the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan are approved and accepted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਕਰ ਭਲੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: se kar bhale jinee har jas lekhaa ||
lines.translation: Those hands which write the Praises of the Lord are good.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਚਰਣ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲੇ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਛਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: se charan suhaave jo har maarag chale hau bal tin sa(n)g pachhaanaa jeeau ||2||
lines.translation: Those feet which walk in the Lord's Way are beautiful. I am a sacrifice to that Congregation in which the Lord is recognized. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun saajan mere meet piaare ||
lines.translation: Listen, O my beloved friends and companions:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g khin maeh udhaare ||
lines.translation: in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be saved in an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟਿ ਹੋਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kilavikh kaaT hoaa man niramal miT ge aavan jaanaa jeeau ||3||
lines.translation: Your sins will be cut out; your mind will be immaculate and pure. Your comings and goings shall cease. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਇਕੁ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhui kar joR ik binau kareejai ||
lines.translation: With my palms pressed together, I offer this prayer:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਪਥਰੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa ddubadhaa pathar leejai ||
lines.translation: please bless me with Your Mercy, and save this sinking stone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kau prabh bhe kirapaalaa prabh naanak man bhaanaa jeeau ||4||22||29||
lines.translation: God has become merciful to Nanak; God is pleasing to Nanak's mind. ||4||22||29||

structure: The shabad begins by blessing the word that speaks Naam and the time spent hearing it.
From there it extends that blessing to eyes, hands, and feet when they move in the Lord's direction.
The closing movement rests in Saadh Sangat, purity, and a humble prayer for mercy on the sinking self.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad begins by blessing words that speak Naam, then blesses eyes, hands, and feet when they turn toward praise, darshan, and the Lord's path. It closes with a prayer that even a sinking stone be lifted by mercy.
evidence.turn: From there it extends that blessing to eyes, hands, and feet when they move in the Lord's direction.
evidence.practicalImplication: This one meets the person whose body is busy all day without much of it turning toward God. Held carefully, it makes ordinary faculties answerable to praise and holy company. Let speech, sight, hands, and feet become honorable through praise.

title: Mercy lets the child tell the truth
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 51
summary: The shabad opens in tenderness and dependence — the soul leans on the Lord's mercy and admits its mistakes as a child would. It then confesses how hard Hukam is to accept and ends in recognition of the Supreme Lord through the Guru.
whyItMatters: This shabad speaks to the part of us that is stuck between shame and self-protection after failure. Stayed with sincerely, it makes confession safer and trust more childlike.
takeaway: Bring the truth about failure into the Lord's mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ghar satvaa ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla, Seventh House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਭਰੋਸੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੈ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: terai bharosai piaare mai laadd laddaiaa ||
lines.translation: Relying on Your Mercy, Dear Lord, I have cherished and loved you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੂਲਹਿ ਚੂਕਹਿ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhooleh chookeh baarik too(n) har pitaa maiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Like a foolish child, I have made mistakes. O Lord, You are my Father and Mother. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਕਹਨੁ ਕਹਾਵਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: suhelaa kahan kahaavan ||
lines.translation: It is easy to speak and talk,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਭਾਵਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa bikham bhaavan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: but it is difficult to accept Your Will. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਕਰਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਜਾਨਉ ਆਪਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau maan taan karau teraa hau jaanau aapaa ||
lines.translation: I stand tall; You are my Strength. I know that You are mine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮਧਿ ਸਭਹਿ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜ ਬਾਪਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabh hee madh sabheh te baahar bemuhataaj baapaa ||2||
lines.translation: Inside of all, and outside of all, You are our Self-sufficient Father. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਤਾ ਹਉ ਜਾਨਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pitaa hau jaanau naahee teree kavan jugataa ||
lines.translation: O Father, I do not know-how can I know Your Way?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਮਮਤਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dhan mukat sa(n)tahu meree raakhai mamataa ||3||
lines.translation: He frees us from bondage, O Saints, and saves us from possessiveness. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਰਹਿਓ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhe kirapaal Thaakur rahio aavan jaanaa ||
lines.translation: Becoming Merciful, my Lord and Master has ended my comings and goings in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੯੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur mil naanak paarabraham pachhaanaa ||4||27||97||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak has recognized the Supreme Lord God. ||4||27||97||

structure: The shabad begins by linking love to mercy and honest childlike admission.
From there it admits how easy speech is and how difficult it is to actually accept Hukam.
The closing movement rests with possessiveness loosening and the Supreme Lord being recognized through the Guru.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad opens in tenderness and dependence — the soul leans on the Lord's mercy and admits its mistakes as a child would. It then confesses how hard Hukam is to accept and ends in recognition of the Supreme Lord through the Guru.
evidence.turn: From there it admits how easy speech is and how difficult it is to actually accept Hukam.
evidence.practicalImplication: This shabad speaks to the part of us that is stuck between shame and self-protection after failure. Stayed with sincerely, it makes confession safer and trust more childlike. Bring the truth about failure into the Lord's mercy.

title: Mercy turns bitter into sweet
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 171
summary: The shabad opens by saying the Lord already dwells in the body-fortress, even though stubbornness cannot taste Him. It travels through mercy, Guru-centered sweetness, and the hard-hearted poison of the manmukh before ending where bitter becomes sweet in Sangat.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person close to sacred things but no longer tasting them. Kept close, it teaches that proximity is not enough; mercy and Shabad must soften the stubborn heart.
takeaway: Keep this in front of you: ask for the mercy that turns nearness into tasted sweetness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
lines.translation: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਗੜ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਧੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: eis gaR meh har raam rai hai kichh saadh na paavai dheeThaa ||
lines.translation: Within this body-fortress is the Lord, the Sovereign Lord King, but the stubborn ones do not find the taste.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਚਖਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har dheen dhiaal anugrahu keeaa har gur sabadhee chakh ddeeThaa ||1||
lines.translation: When the Lord, Merciful to the meek, showed His Mercy, I found and tasted it, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਲਿਵ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam har keeratan gur liv meeThaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Lovingly focused upon the Guru, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise has become sweet to me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਿ ਬਸੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har agam agochar paarabraham hai mil satigur laag baseeThaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord, the Supreme Lord God, is Inaccessible and Unfathomable. Those who are committed to the True Guru, the Divine Intermediary, meet the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਤਿਨ ਆਗੈ ਆਣਿ ਪਰੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jin gur bachan sukhaane heearai tin aagai aan pareeThaa ||2||
lines.translation: Those whose hearts are pleased with the Guru's Teachings - the Lord's Presence is revealed to them. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੀਅਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: manmukh heearaa at kaThor hai tin a(n)tar kaar kareeThaa ||
lines.translation: The hearts of the self-willed manmukhs are hard and cruel; their inner beings are dark.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਆਈਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਫੋਲਿ ਫੁਲੀਠਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: biseear kau bahu dhoodh peeaaieeaai bikh nikasai fol fuleeThaa ||3||
lines.translation: Even if the poisonous snake is fed large amounts of milk, it will still yield only poison. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਘਸਿ ਗਰੁੜੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har prabh aan milaavahu gur saadhoo ghas garuR sabadh mukh leeThaa ||
lines.translation: O Lord God, please unite me with the Holy Guru, so that I might joyfully grind and eat the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਲਾਲੇ ਗੋਲੇ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰੂਆ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੨੩॥੬੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gur ke laale gole lag sa(n)gat karooaa meeThaa ||4||9||23||61||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Guru; in the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, the bitter becomes sweet. ||4||9||23||61||

structure: The shabad begins by exposing the tragedy of living near the treasure without tasting it.
From there it contrasts the sweetness given through Guru and Shabad with the poison of the hard heart.
The closing movement rests in prayer for union, Sangat, and the miracle of bitterness becoming sweet.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad opens by saying the Lord already dwells in the body-fortress, even though stubbornness cannot taste Him. It travels through mercy, Guru-centered sweetness, and the hard-hearted poison of the manmukh before ending where bitter becomes sweet in Sangat.
evidence.turn: From there it contrasts the sweetness given through Guru and Shabad with the poison of the hard heart.
evidence.practicalImplication: This one meets the person close to sacred things but no longer tasting them. Kept close, it teaches that proximity is not enough; mercy and Shabad must soften the stubborn heart. Keep this in front of you: ask for the mercy that turns nearness into tasted sweetness.

title: Naam planted within clears the inner fog
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 86
summary: The shabad opens with the Perfect Guru implanting the Name and dispelling inner doubt. It travels through praise as light, ego conquered into one-pointedness, and ends where life itself depends on Naam.
whyItMatters: This speaks to the person trapped in inner fog, repeated uncertainty, or spiritual confusion. Stayed with, it shows that doubt thins when Naam is planted deeply enough to become direction.
takeaway: Remember this: when Naam is planted within, doubt loses its house.

lines.transliteration: mahalaa teejaa ||
lines.translation: Third Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har naam dhiRaiaa tin vichahu bharam chukaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord within me. It has dispelled my doubts from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਮਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam har keerat gaiee kar chaanan mag dhikhaiaa ||
lines.translation: I sing the Lord's Name and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; the Divine Light shines, and now I see the Way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maar ek liv laagee a(n)tar naam vasaiaa ||
lines.translation: Conquering my ego, I am lovingly focused on the One Lord; the Naam has come to dwell within me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurmatee jam joh na saakai saachai naam samaiaa ||
lines.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, I cannot be touched by the Messenger of Death. I am absorbed in the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh aape aap varatai karataa jo bhaavai so nai laiaa ||
lines.translation: The Creator Himself is All-pervading everywhere; He links those with whom He is pleased to His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏ ਤਾ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam le taa jeevai bin naavai khin mar jaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak chants the Naam, and so he lives. Without the Name, he would die in an instant. ||2||

structure: The shabad starts with the Guru placing Naam inside and scattering doubt.
From there it turns praise into illumination and one-pointed focus through the defeat of ego.
The closing movement rests by making Naam the condition of real life rather than a devotional extra.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad opens with the Perfect Guru implanting the Name and dispelling inner doubt. It travels through praise as light, ego conquered into one-pointedness, and ends where life itself depends on Naam.
evidence.turn: From there it turns praise into illumination and one-pointed focus through the defeat of ego.
evidence.practicalImplication: This speaks to the person trapped in inner fog, repeated uncertainty, or spiritual confusion. Stayed with, it shows that doubt thins when Naam is planted deeply enough to become direction. Remember this: when Naam is planted within, doubt loses its house.

title: Nearness ends the frantic search
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 205
summary: The shabad opens in astonished intimacy — the Lord is no longer distant but known by grace. It carries the listener through anxiety cut away, pain and pleasure losing their tyranny, and ends with essence merging into Essence.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person worn out by searching, petitioning, and looking elsewhere for relief. Kept near, it teaches rest by revealing the nearness that restless effort keeps missing.
takeaway: Let grace make the Lord near enough to stop the chase.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa panjavaa ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਪਰਚਉ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaiso parachau paio ||
lines.translation: I am intimate with Him;

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਬੀਠੁਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਝਹਿ ਬਤਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karee kirapaa dhiaal beeThulai satigur mujheh bataio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: granting His Grace, my Kind Beloved has told me of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਸੁਆਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: jat kat dhekhau tat tat tum hee moh ih bisuaas hoi aaio ||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, there You are; I am totally convinced of this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਉ ਸੁਨਤੋ ਹੈ ਰਘੁਰਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kai peh karau aradhaas benatee jau sunato hai raghuraio ||1||
lines.translation: Unto whom should I pray? The Lord Himself hears all. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਹਿਓ ਸਹਸਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਤੋਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: lahio sahasaa ba(n)dhan gur tore taa(n) sadhaa sahaj sukh paio ||
lines.translation: My anxiety is over. The Guru has cut away my bonds, and I have found eternal peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਣਾ ਸਾ ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਸੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਹਾ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: honaa saa soiee fun hosee sukh dhukh kahaa dhikhaio ||2||
lines.translation: Whatever shall be, shall be in the end; so where can pain and pleasure be seen? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਠਾਣਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਰਦਾ ਖੋਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd kaa eko Thaanaa gur paradhaa khol dhikhaio ||
lines.translation: The continents and the solar systems rest in the support of the One Lord. The Guru has removed the veil of illusion, and shown this to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ ਤਉ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕੈਠੈ ਜਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: nau nidh naam nidhaan ik Thaiee tau baahar kaiThai jaio ||3||
lines.translation: The nine treasures of the wealth of the Name of the Lord are in that one place. Where else should we go? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਰਚਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekai kanik anik bhaat saajee bahu parakaar rachaio ||
lines.translation: The same gold is fashioned into various articles; just so, the Lord has made the many patterns of the creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਈ ਹੈ ਇਵ ਤਤੈ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak bharam gur khoiee hai iv tatai tat milaio ||4||2||123||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt; in this way, my essence merges into God's essence. ||4||2||123||

structure: The shabad starts with grace making intimacy possible instead of merely imagined.
From there it loosens anxiety and the drama of pain and pleasure once the veil is removed.
The closing movement rests in the non-separation of essence meeting Essence through the Guru.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad opens in astonished intimacy — the Lord is no longer distant but known by grace. It carries the listener through anxiety cut away, pain and pleasure losing their tyranny, and ends with essence merging into Essence.
evidence.turn: From there it loosens anxiety and the drama of pain and pleasure once the veil is removed.
evidence.practicalImplication: This one meets the person worn out by searching, petitioning, and looking elsewhere for relief. Kept near, it teaches rest by revealing the nearness that restless effort keeps missing. Let grace make the Lord near enough to stop the chase.

title: Offering everything to the One who can unite you
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 256
summary: This shabad begins by giving up private bargaining and asking to be brought near to the Divine. It closes with fear losing its final authority.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person whose fear has started feeling personal and total. Kept close, it turns the heart from private bargaining toward union, clarity, and release from dread.
takeaway: Fear loosens when the heart is brought near to the One it was made for.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Shalok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਤਿਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man dhan arapau tisai prabhoo milaavai moh ||
lines.translation: I offer my body, mind and wealth to anyone who can unite me with God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਉ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੋਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhram bhau kaaTeeaai chookai jam kee joh ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, my doubts and fears have been dispelled, and the Messenger of Death does not see me any longer. ||1||

structure: The shabad starts with total offering and a plain request for union with the Divine.
From there it keeps pressing past fear and doubt instead of negotiating with them.
The closing movement rests in freedom, where dread no longer gets to govern the soul.

evidence.coreClaim: This shabad begins by giving up private bargaining and asking to be brought near to the Divine. It closes with fear losing its final authority.
evidence.turn: From there it keeps pressing past fear and doubt instead of negotiating with them.
evidence.practicalImplication: This one meets the person whose fear has started feeling personal and total. Kept close, it turns the heart from private bargaining toward union, clarity, and release from dread. Fear loosens when the heart is brought near to the One it was made for.

title: One instant of remembrance outweighs drift
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 239
summary: The shabad opens by contrasting a life without remembrance with a life given even one true instant of simran. It then presses the contrast hard, exposing what drift becomes without the Name and where mercy finally leads.
whyItMatters: This is for anyone who keeps excusing distraction because it looks ordinary. Stayed with honestly, it restores seriousness to remembrance and makes one real instant feel weightier than a long wasted stretch.
takeaway: Remember this: guard one true instant of simran against a thousand distracted ones.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa panjavaa ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਸਰਪ ਆਰਜਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin simaran jaise sarap aarajaaree ||
lines.translation: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one's life is like that of a snake.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tiau jeeveh saakat naam bisaaree ||1||
lines.translation: This is how the faithless cynic lives, forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek nimakh jo simaran meh jeeaa ||
lines.translation: One who lives in meditative remembrance, even for an instant,

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਲਾਖ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: koT dhinas laakh sadhaa thir theeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: lives for hundreds of thousands and millions of days, and becomes stable forever. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin simaran dhirag karam karaas ||
lines.translation: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one's actions and works are cursed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਗ ਬਤਨ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਸ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaag batan bisaTaa meh vaas ||2||
lines.translation: Like the crow's beak, he dwells in manure. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਭਏ ਕੂਕਰ ਕਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin simaran bhe kookar kaam ||
lines.translation: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one acts like a dog.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਬੇਸੁਆ ਪੂਤ ਨਿਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saakat besuaa poot ninaam ||3||
lines.translation: The faithless cynic is nameless, like the prostitute's son. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੀਙ ਛਤਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin simaran jaise seen(g) chhataaraa ||
lines.translation: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a horned ram.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਹਿ ਕੂਰੁ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: boleh koor saakat mukh kaaraa ||4||
lines.translation: The faithless cynic barks out his lies, and his face is blackened. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਗਰਧਭ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin simaran garadhabh kee niaaiee ||
lines.translation: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a donkey.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਥਾਨ ਭਰਿਸਟ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: saakat thaan bharisaT firaahee ||5||
lines.translation: The faithless cynic wanders around in polluted places. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੂਕਰ ਹਰਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin simaran kookar harakaiaa ||
lines.translation: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a mad dog.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਲੋਭੀ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: saakat lobhee ba(n)dh na paiaa ||6||
lines.translation: The greedy, faithless cynic falls into entanglements. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਹੈ ਆਤਮ ਘਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin simaran hai aatam ghaatee ||
lines.translation: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, he murders his own soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਨੀਚ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: saakat neech tis kul nahee jaatee ||7||
lines.translation: The faithless cynic is wretched, without family or social standing. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis bhiaa kirapaal tis satasa(n)g milaiaa ||
lines.translation: When the Lord becomes merciful, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak gur jagat taraiaa ||8||7||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has saved the world. ||8||7||

structure: The shabad begins by showing how even one instant of remembrance stabilizes a life.
From there it intensifies the warning by showing what actions and identity become without the Name.
The closing movement rests in mercy joining the soul to true company and the Guru's saving work.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad opens by contrasting a life without remembrance with a life given even one true instant of simran. It then presses the contrast hard, exposing what drift becomes without the Name and where mercy finally leads.
evidence.turn: From there it intensifies the warning by showing what actions and identity become without the Name.
evidence.practicalImplication: This is for anyone who keeps excusing distraction because it looks ordinary. Stayed with honestly, it restores seriousness to remembrance and makes one real instant feel weightier than a long wasted stretch. Remember this: guard one true instant of simran against a thousand distracted ones.

title: True bankers trade in Naam
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 257
summary: The pauree opens by saying the mind's wandering stops in the company of saints. It then names the true bankers as those whose wealth is the Name and whose patience, honor, and glory ripen from listening well.
whyItMatters: This shabad speaks to the part of us that chases quick gains, visible results, or restless proof. Stayed with consistently, it redefines wealth, slows the heart, and lets patience become a real form of honor.
takeaway: Trade in Naam, and let patience ripen into honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਤਉ ਮਿਟੈ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhadhaa dhaavat tau miTai sa(n)tasa(n)g hoi baas ||
lines.translation: DHADHA: The mind's wanderings cease, when one comes to dwell in the Society of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰ ਤੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਹਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhur te kirapaa karahu aap tau hoi maneh paragaas ||
lines.translation: If the Lord is Merciful from the very beginning, then one's mind is enlightened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਤੇਊ ਸਚ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan saachaa teuoo sach saahaa ||
lines.translation: Those who have the true wealth are the true bankers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਸਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har poo(n)jee naam bisaahaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, is their wealth, and they trade in His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੀਰਜੁ ਜਸੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਤਿਹ ਬਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dheeraj jas sobhaa teh baniaa ||
lines.translation: Patience, glory and honor come to those

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਜਿਹ ਸੁਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam sravan jeh suniaa ||
lines.translation: who listen to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jeh ghaT rahe samaiee ||
lines.translation: That Gurmukh whose heart remains merged with the Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak teh jan milee vaddaiee ||35||
lines.translation: O Nanak, obtains glorious greatness. ||35||

structure: The shabad begins by placing the wandering mind inside saintly company until it begins to settle.
From there it redefines wealth as the Lord's Name rather than worldly holdings.
The closing movement rests with patience, glory, and greatness growing in the heart that keeps listening.

evidence.coreClaim: The pauree opens by saying the mind's wandering stops in the company of saints. It then names the true bankers as those whose wealth is the Name and whose patience, honor, and glory ripen from listening well.
evidence.turn: From there it redefines wealth as the Lord's Name rather than worldly holdings.
evidence.practicalImplication: This shabad speaks to the part of us that chases quick gains, visible results, or restless proof. Stayed with consistently, it redefines wealth, slows the heart, and lets patience become a real form of honor. Trade in Naam, and let patience ripen into honor.

title: Peace comes through serving the True Guru
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 85
summary: The shabad starts by joining service, peace, and the treasure of the True Name. It deepens through self-recognition, inner light, truthfulness, and praise that returns body and soul to the Lord.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person wanting peace without surrendering the center seat. Reach for it before self-justification or image-management takes over, and it will press peace back through service, recognition, and praise.
takeaway: Serve first, and let peace expose the self.

lines.transliteration: mahalaa teejaa ||
lines.translation: Third Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sev sukh paiaa sach naam gunataas ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained. The True Name is the Treasure of Excellence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurmatee aap pachhaaniaa raam naam paragaas ||
lines.translation: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and recognize your own self; the Divine Light of the Lord's Name shall shine within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sacho sach kamaavanaa vaddiaaiee vadde paas ||
lines.translation: The true ones practice Truth; greatness rests in the Great Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tis kaa sifat kare aradhaas ||
lines.translation: Body, soul and all things belong to the Lord-praise Him, and offer your prayers to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabadh saalaahanaa sukhe sukh nivaas ||
lines.translation: Sing the Praises of the True Lord through the Word of His Shabad, and you shall abide in the peace of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam manai maeh bin naavai dhirag jeevaas ||
lines.translation: You may practice chanting, penance and austere self-discipline within your mind, but without the Name, life is useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurmatee naau paieeaai manmukh moh vinaas ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Name is obtained, while the self-willed manmukh wastes away in emotional attachment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh too(n) naanak teraa dhaas ||2||
lines.translation: Please protect me, by the Pleasure of Your Will. Nanak is Your slave. ||2||

structure: The shabad begins by making service the doorway into peace and the Name's treasure.
From there it lets the Guru's teaching expose the self and light it from within.
The closing movement rests by returning body, soul, and praise to the Lord who held them all along.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad starts by joining service, peace, and the treasure of the True Name. It deepens through self-recognition, inner light, truthfulness, and praise that returns body and soul to the Lord.
evidence.turn: From there it lets the Guru's teaching expose the self and light it from within.
evidence.practicalImplication: This one meets the person wanting peace without surrendering the center seat. Reach for it before self-justification or image-management takes over, and it will press peace back through service, recognition, and praise. Serve first, and let peace expose the self.

title: Pervasiveness cures the scarcity behind comparison
subtitle: Raag Maajh · Ang 120
summary: The shabad begins by naming the Divine in all colors and forms. It then contrasts human cycling and change with the Eternal One and comes to rest in understanding received through the Guru.
whyItMatters: This is for anyone whose eyes keep narrowing into comparison and competition. Stayed with honestly, it breaks the scarcity spell by revealing a world already full of the One.
takeaway: Keep this in front of you: comparison weakens when the world is seen as already filled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਰਨ ਰੂਪ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: varan roop varateh sabh tere ||
lines.translation: In all colors and forms, You are pervading.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਫੇਰ ਪਵਹਿ ਘਣੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mar mar ja(n)meh fer paveh ghanere ||
lines.translation: People die over and over again; they are re-born, and make their rounds on the wheel of reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) eko nihachal agam apaaraa gurmatee boojh bujhaavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: You alone are Eternal and Unchanging, Inaccessible and Infinite. Through the Guru's Teachings, understanding is imparted. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree raam naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Lord's Name in their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਵਰਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis roop na rekhiaa varan na koiee gurmatee aap bujhaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Lord has no form, features or color. Through the Guru's Teachings, He inspires us to understand Him. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ekaa jot jaanai je koiee ||
lines.translation: The One Light is all-pervading; only a few know this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seviaai paragaT hoiee ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, this is revealed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gupat paragaT varatai sabh thaiee jotee jot milaavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: In the hidden and in the obvious, He is pervading all places. Our light merges into the Light. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tisanaa agan jalai sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: The world is burning in the fire of desire,

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਭੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: lobh abhimaan bahut aha(n)kaaraa ||
lines.translation: in greed, arrogance and excessive ego.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਏ ਅਪਣੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mar mar janamai pat gavaae apanee birathaa janam gavaavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: People die over and over again; they are re-born, and lose their honor. They waste away their lives in vain. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabadh ko viralaa boojhai ||
lines.translation: Those who understand the Word of the Guru's Shabad are very rare.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap maare taa tirabhavan soojhai ||
lines.translation: Those who subdue their egotism, come to know the three worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: fir oh marai na maranaa hovai sahaje sach samaavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: Then, they die, never to die again. They are intuitively absorbed in the True One. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: maiaa meh fir chit na laae ||
lines.translation: They do not focus their consciousness on Maya again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabadh sadh rahai samaae ||
lines.translation: They remain absorbed forever in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sach salaahe sabh ghaT a(n)tar sacho sach suhaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: They praise the True One, who is contained deep within all hearts. They are blessed and exalted by the Truest of the True. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach saalaahee sadhaa hajoore ||
lines.translation: Praise the True One, who is Ever-present.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabadh rahiaa bharapoore ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is pervading everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadhee sach nadharee aavai sache hee sukh paavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, we come to behold the True One; from the True One, peace is obtained. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach man a(n)dhar rahiaa samai ||
lines.translation: The True One permeates and pervades the mind within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadhaa sach nihachal aavai na jai ||
lines.translation: The True One is Eternal and Unchanging; He does not come and go in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sache laagai so man niramal gurmatee sach samaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: Those who are attached to the True One are immaculate and pure. Through the Guru's Teachings, they merge in the True One. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach saalaahee avar na koiee ||
lines.translation: Praise the True One, and no other.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit seviaai sadhaa sukh hoiee ||
lines.translation: Serving Him, eternal peace is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੮॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate veechaaree sacho sach kamaavaniaa ||8||18||19||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, reflect deeply on the Truth; they practice only Truth. ||8||18||19||

structure: The shabad begins by placing the Divine inside every color and form the mind wants to divide.
From there it contrasts human change and cycling with the Eternal One who does not thin out.
The closing movement rests with understanding gifted through the Guru instead of seized through comparison.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad begins by naming the Divine in all colors and forms. It then contrasts human cycling and change with the Eternal One and comes to rest in understanding received through the Guru.
evidence.turn: From there it contrasts human change and cycling with the Eternal One who does not thin out.
evidence.practicalImplication: This is for anyone whose eyes keep narrowing into comparison and competition. Stayed with honestly, it breaks the scarcity spell by revealing a world already full of the One. Keep this in front of you: comparison weakens when the world is seen as already filled.

title: Place the tired mind in the Guru's cooling shelter
subtitle: Raag Maajh · Ang 137
summary: This tiny shabad wastes no movement. It names the Guru as giver, cooling house, and light of the three worlds, then lands on one instruction: place the mind's trust there and peace will come.
whyItMatters: This is for the worn-down person who keeps spending trust on supports that do not cool anything. Return to it when exhaustion makes you grab for quick relief; it teaches peace as reliance, not one more effort.
takeaway: Place the mind's trust in the Guru as cooling shelter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਰ ਮਾਝ ਕੀ ਤਥਾ ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧  ਮਲਕ ਮੁਰੀਦ ਤਥਾ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਹੜਾ ਸੋਹੀਆ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ਗਾਵਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaar maajh kee tathaa salok mahalaa pehilaa  malak mureedh tathaa cha(n)dhrahaRaa soheeaa kee dhunee gaavanee ||
lines.translation: Vaar In Maajh, And Shaloks Of The First Mehla: To Be Sung To The Tune Of ""Malik Mureed And Chandrahraa Sohee-Aa""

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaadh ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
lines.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਿਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਤਿਹ ਲੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur dhaataa gur hivai ghar gur dheepak teh loi ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Giver; the Guru is the House of ice. The Guru is the Light of the three worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਮਰ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: amar padhaarath naanakaa man maaniaai sukh hoi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, He is everlasting wealth. Place your mind's faith in Him, and you shall find peace. ||1||

structure: The shabad begins by naming the Guru as giver rather than as one more burden on the seeker.
From there it calls the Guru a cooling house and a light broad enough for all three worlds.
The closing movement rests by treating that light as lasting wealth and peace.

evidence.coreClaim: This tiny shabad wastes no movement. It names the Guru as giver, cooling house, and light of the three worlds, then lands on one instruction: place the mind's trust there and peace will come.
evidence.turn: From there it calls the Guru a cooling house and a light broad enough for all three worlds.
evidence.practicalImplication: This is for the worn-down person who keeps spending trust on supports that do not cool anything. Return to it when exhaustion makes you grab for quick relief; it teaches peace as reliance, not one more effort. Place the mind's trust in the Guru as cooling shelter.

title: Praise breaks the illusion of mastery
subtitle: Jap · Ang 1
summary: The shabad begins with many voices singing different dimensions of the Lord's power, gifts, beauty, knowledge, making, and unmaking. It opens the field so wide that control, ownership, and single-angle thinking start to look small.
whyItMatters: This shabad speaks to the part of us that grips reality too tightly and mistaking analysis for authority. Stayed with honestly, it restores scale and invites praise where the mind wanted to dominate.
takeaway: The proper response to vastness is praise, not possession.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavai ko taan hovai kisai taan ||
lines.translation: Some sing of His Power-who has that Power?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavai ko dhaat jaanai neesaan ||
lines.translation: Some sing of His Gifts, and know His Sign and Insignia.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਗੁਣ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਚਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavai ko gun vaddiaaieeaa chaar ||
lines.translation: Some sing of His Glorious Virtues, Greatness and Beauty.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਵਿਖਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavai ko vidhiaa vikham veechaar ||
lines.translation: Some sing of knowledge obtained of Him, through difficult philosophical studies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸਾਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavai ko saaj kare tan kheh ||
lines.translation: Some sing that He fashions the body, and then again reduces it to dust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਜੀਅ ਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavai ko jeea lai fir dheh ||
lines.translation: Some sing that He takes life away, and then again restores it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavai ko jaapai dhisai dhoor ||
lines.translation: Some sing that He seems so very far away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਾਦਰਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavai ko vekhai haadharaa hadhoor ||
lines.translation: Some sing that He watches over us, face to face, ever-present.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਥਨਾ ਕਥੀ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੋਟਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kathanaa kathee na aavai toT ||
lines.translation: There is no shortage of those who preach and teach.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਕਥੀ ਕੋਟੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kath kath kathee koTee koT koT ||
lines.translation: Millions upon millions offer millions of sermons and stories.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਦਾ ਦੇ ਲੈਦੇ ਥਕਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhedhaa dhe laidhe thak paeh ||
lines.translation: The Great Giver keeps on giving, while those who receive grow weary of receiving.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਾ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਖਾਹੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jugaa juga(n)tar khaahee khaeh ||
lines.translation: Throughout the ages, consumers consume.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukamee hukam chalaae raahu ||
lines.translation: The Commander, by His Command, leads us to walk on the Path.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vigasai veparavaahu ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, He blossoms forth, Carefree and Untroubled. ||3||

structure: The shabad starts with many songs rising around the Lord's power, gifts, beauty, and knowledge.
From there it keeps widening the field until life, death, nearness, and distance all fall inside divine action.
The closing movement rests by making mastery look too small for the reality praise is standing before.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad begins with many voices singing different dimensions of the Lord's power, gifts, beauty, knowledge, making, and unmaking. It opens the field so wide that control, ownership, and single-angle thinking start to look small.
evidence.turn: From there it keeps widening the field until life, death, nearness, and distance all fall inside divine action.
evidence.practicalImplication: This shabad speaks to the part of us that grips reality too tightly and mistaking analysis for authority. Stayed with honestly, it restores scale and invites praise where the mind wanted to dominate. The proper response to vastness is praise, not possession.

title: Praise melts what comparison hardens
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 18
summary: The shabad opens with metal merging into metal and uses that image to describe praise absorbed into the Praiseworthy Lord. It carries the listener through saintly dust, true action, and the home of the self being found within.
whyItMatters: This is for anyone whose mind keeps hardening around comparison, self-consciousness, or restless ambition. Kept near, it softens the separate self and turns it toward praise, holy company, and homecoming.
takeaway: Let praise, saintly company, and true action soften the self into homecoming.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahal pehilaa ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਉ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaat milai fun dhaat kau sifatee sifat samai ||
lines.translation: As metal merges with metal, those who chant the Praises of the Lord are absorbed into the Praiseworthy Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੁ ਗੁਲਾਲੁ ਗਹਬਰਾ ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: laal gulaal gahabaraa sachaa ra(n)g chaRaau ||
lines.translation: Like the poppies, they are dyed in the deep crimson color of Truthfulness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sach milai sa(n)tokheeaa har jap ekai bhai ||1||
lines.translation: Those contented souls who meditate on the Lord with single-minded love, meet the True Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaiee re sa(n)t janaa kee ren ||
lines.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, become the dust of the feet of the humble Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਧੇਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t sabhaa gur paieeaai mukat padhaarath dhen ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In the Society of the Saints, the Guru is found. He is the Treasure of Liberation, the Source of all good fortune. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚਉ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: uoochau thaan suhaavanaa uoopar mahal muraar ||
lines.translation: Upon that Highest Plane of Sublime Beauty, stands the Mansion of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਦੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach karanee dhe paieeaai dhar ghar mahal piaar ||
lines.translation: By true actions, this human body is obtained, and the door within ourselves which leads to the Mansion of the Beloved, is found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gurmukh man samajhaieeaai aatam raam beechaar ||2||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs train their minds to contemplate the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈਅਹਿ ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tirabidh karam kamaie'eeh aas a(n)dhesaa hoi ||
lines.translation: By actions committed under the influence of the three qualities, hope and anxiety are produced.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੁਟਸੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiau gur bin tirakuTee chhuTasee sahaj miliaai sukh hoi ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, how can anyone be released from these three qualities? Through intuitive wisdom, we meet with Him and find peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: nij ghar mahal pachhaaneeaai nadhar kare mal dhoi ||3||
lines.translation: Within the home of the self, the Mansion of His Presence is realized when He bestows His Glance of Grace and washes away our pollution. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਉ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur mail na utarai bin har kiau ghar vaas ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, this pollution is not removed. Without the Lord, how can there be any homecoming?

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਆਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: eko sabadh veechaareeaai avar tiaagai aas ||
lines.translation: Contemplate the One Word of the Shabad, and abandon other hopes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dhekh dhikhaieeaai hau sadh balihaarai jaas ||4||12||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to the one who beholds, and inspires others to behold Him. ||4||12||

structure: The shabad begins by picturing praise as fusion instead of performance.
From there it turns toward saintly company, true action, and the Guru as the way beyond anxiety and the three qualities.
The closing movement rests in homecoming, where other hopes are abandoned and the One is beheld.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad opens with metal merging into metal and uses that image to describe praise absorbed into the Praiseworthy Lord. It carries the listener through saintly dust, true action, and the home of the self being found within.
evidence.turn: From there it turns toward saintly company, true action, and the Guru as the way beyond anxiety and the three qualities.
evidence.practicalImplication: This is for anyone whose mind keeps hardening around comparison, self-consciousness, or restless ambition. Kept near, it softens the separate self and turns it toward praise, holy company, and homecoming. Let praise, saintly company, and true action soften the self into homecoming.

title: Recognize greatness by the shelter it offers
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 273
summary: This section refuses to let greatness stay abstract. The God-conscious being is described in vast terms, then recognized by what that vastness does: helps the helpless, extends a hand, and gives the way of liberation.
whyItMatters: This is for anyone who needs real guidance and for the person tempted to admire stature without testing its fruit. Return to it when spirituality gets vague; it teaches you to look for shelter, help, and an outstretched hand.
takeaway: Keep this in front of you: test greatness by the shelter it gives away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee sabh sirasaT kaa karataa ||
lines.translation: The God-conscious being is the Creator of all the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਦ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee sadh jeevai nahee marataa ||
lines.translation: The God-conscious being lives forever, and does not die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee mukat jugat jeea kaa dhaataa ||
lines.translation: The God-conscious being is the Giver of the way of liberation of the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee pooran purakh bidhaataa ||
lines.translation: The God-conscious being is the Perfect Supreme Being, who orchestrates all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਅਨਾਥ ਕਾ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee anaath kaa naath ||
lines.translation: The God-conscious being is the helper of the helpless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee kaa sabh uoopar haath ||
lines.translation: The God-conscious being extends his hand to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee kaa sagal akaar ||
lines.translation: The God-conscious being owns the entire creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee aap nira(n)kaar ||
lines.translation: The God-conscious being is himself the Formless Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee kee sobhaa braham giaanee banee ||
lines.translation: The glory of the God-conscious being belongs to the God-conscious being alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਾ ਧਨੀ ॥੮॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak braham giaanee sarab kaa dhanee ||8||8||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is the Lord of all. ||8||8||

structure: The shabad begins by naming the God-conscious being through enduring, God-shaped qualities.
From there it turns that stature toward liberation, orchestration, and concrete help.
The closing movement rests by placing a hand extended to all at the center of true spiritual power.

evidence.coreClaim: This section refuses to let greatness stay abstract. The God-conscious being is described in vast terms, then recognized by what that vastness does: helps the helpless, extends a hand, and gives the way of liberation.
evidence.turn: From there it turns that stature toward liberation, orchestration, and concrete help.
evidence.practicalImplication: This is for anyone who needs real guidance and for the person tempted to admire stature without testing its fruit. Return to it when spirituality gets vague; it teaches you to look for shelter, help, and an outstretched hand. Keep this in front of you: test greatness by the shelter it gives away.

title: Release arrives where seeking kneels into service
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 52
summary: The shabad begins by declaring that release comes only through the True Name. It turns seeking toward the Guru's feet, true service, and the hidden Lord found when the True Guru is pleased.
whyItMatters: This speaks to the person who keeps searching but cannot land. Taken steadily, it ends the addiction to spiritual novelty and teaches that arrival comes through service, not endless roaming.
takeaway: Keep this in front of you: seeking matures when it bows into the Name and service.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janahu sun bhaieeho chhooTan saachai nai ||
lines.translation: O Saints, O Siblings of Destiny, listen: release comes only through the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵਣੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur ke charan sarevane teerath har kaa naau ||
lines.translation: Worship the Feet of the Guru. Let the Name of the Lord be your sacred shrine of pilgrimage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮੰਨੀਅਹਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aagai dharageh ma(n)ne'eeh milai nithaave thaau ||1||
lines.translation: Hereafter, you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord; there, even the homeless find a home. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaiee re saachee satigur sev ||
lines.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, service to the True Guru alone is True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur tuThai paieeaai pooran alakh abhev ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: When the True Guru is pleased, we obtain the Perfect, Unseen, Unknowable Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur viTahu vaariaa jin dhitaa sach naau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has bestowed the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadhin sach salaahanaa sache ke gun gaau ||
lines.translation: Night and day, I praise the True One; I sing the Glorious Praises of the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sach khaanaa sach painanaa sache sachaa naau ||2||
lines.translation: True is the food, and true are the clothes, of those who chant the True Name of the True One. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸਫਲੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saas giraas na visarai safal moorat gur aap ||
lines.translation: With each breath and morsel of food, do not forget the Guru, the Embodiment of Fulfillment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਿਸਈ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur jevadd avar na dhisiee aaTh pahar tis jaap ||
lines.translation: None is seen to be as great as the Guru. Meditate on Him twenty-four hours a day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: nadhar kare taa paieeaai sach naam gunataas ||3||
lines.translation: As He casts His Glance of Grace, we obtain the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur paramesar ek hai sabh meh rahiaa samai ||
lines.translation: The Guru and the Transcendent Lord are one and the same, pervading and permeating amongst all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa seiee naam dhiaai ||
lines.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, meditate on the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੧੦੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gur saranaagatee marai na aavai jai ||4||30||100||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Guru, who does not die, or come and go in reincarnation. ||4||30||100||

structure: The shabad begins by stripping release away from every substitute except the True Name.
From there it turns the seeker toward the Guru's feet until even homelessness becomes sheltered.
The closing movement rests by calling service to the True Guru the one path that actually arrives.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad begins by declaring that release comes only through the True Name. It turns seeking toward the Guru's feet, true service, and the hidden Lord found when the True Guru is pleased.
evidence.turn: From there it turns the seeker toward the Guru's feet until even homelessness becomes sheltered.
evidence.practicalImplication: This speaks to the person who keeps searching but cannot land. Taken steadily, it ends the addiction to spiritual novelty and teaches that arrival comes through service, not endless roaming. Keep this in front of you: seeking matures when it bows into the Name and service.

title: Remember the Guru with every breath
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 239
summary: The shabad begins with breath-by-breath remembrance of the Guru as life and wealth. It moves through service, the washing of ego, rescue from inner fire, and finally rests in the certainty that the Guru is powerful enough to carry the soul.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person who feels restless, isolated, or afraid that faith will collapse under pressure. Kept close, it turns remembrance from duty into lifeline, and lets gratitude steady what fear keeps shaking.
takeaway: Keep returning to the Guru as breath, wealth, and shelter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa panjavaa ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis gur kau simarau saas saas ||
lines.translation: I remember the Guru with each and every breath.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur mere praan satigur meree raas ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Guru is my breath of life, the True Guru is my wealth. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa dharasan dhekh dhekh jeevaa ||
lines.translation: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I live.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur ke charan dhoi dhoi peevaa ||1||
lines.translation: I wash the Guru's Feet, and drink in this water. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਨਿਤ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee ren nit majan karau ||
lines.translation: I take my daily bath in the dust of the Guru's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਹਰਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam kee haumai mal harau ||2||
lines.translation: The egotistical filth of countless incarnations is washed off. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਝੂਲਾਵਉ ਪਾਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis gur kau jhoolaavau paakhaa ||
lines.translation: I wave the fan over the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੇ ਹਾਥੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa agan te haath dhe raakhaa ||3||
lines.translation: Giving me His Hand, He has saved me from the great fire. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਢੋਵਉ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis gur kai gireh ddovau paanee ||
lines.translation: I carry water for the Guru's household;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਅਕਲ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jis gur te akal gat jaanee ||4||
lines.translation: from the Guru, I have learned the Way of the One Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪੀਸਉ ਨੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis gur kai gireh peesau neet ||
lines.translation: I grind the corn for the Guru's household.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵੈਰੀ ਸਭ ਮੀਤ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jis parasaadh vairee sabh meet ||5||
lines.translation: By His Grace, all my enemies have become friends. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin gur mo kau dheenaa jeeau ||
lines.translation: The Guru who gave me my soul,

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁਨਾ ਦਾਸਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਮੁਲਿ ਲੀਉ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: aapunaa dhaasaraa aape mul leeau ||6||
lines.translation: has Himself purchased me, and made me His slave. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇਓ ਅਪਨਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape laio apanaa piaar ||
lines.translation: He Himself has blessed me with His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਕਰੀ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sadhaa sadhaa tis gur kau karee namasakaar ||7||
lines.translation: Forever and ever, I humbly bow to the Guru. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਭੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kal kales bhai bhram dhukh laathaa ||
