lines.transliteration: gur kai sa(n)g tariaa sabh log ||5||
lines.translation: In the Company of the Guru, all the people of the world are saved. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan mere kaaraj sidh ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, my affairs are resolved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan paiaa naau nidh ||6||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, I have obtained the nine treasures. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin jin keenee mere gur kee aasaa ||
lines.translation: Whoever places his hopes in my Guru,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: tis kee kaTeeaai jam kee faasaa ||7||
lines.translation: has the noose of death cut away. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan jaagiaa meraa karam ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, my good karma has been awakened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥੮॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gur bheTiaa paarabraham ||8||8||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meeting with the Guru, I have found the Supreme Lord God. ||8||8||

structure: The shabad begins by naming the highest state as something received through the Guru's word.
From there it contrasts outer striving with the inward changes the Guru actually works.
The closing movement rests by locating fulfillment in meeting the Supreme Lord through the Guru.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad keeps returning to what the Guru's word does from the inside — it lifts the seeker beyond self-made rank, steadies the mind, and joins the heart to the Supreme Lord. What looks like attainment from the outside is recast as what the Guru actually causes within.
evidence.turn: From there it contrasts outer striving with the inward changes the Guru actually works.
evidence.practicalImplication: This shabad speaks to the part of us that chases improvement, image, or spiritual status without steady submission to the Guru's word. Taken seriously, it turns attainment from display into inward settlement. Remember this: let the Guru's word define attainment.

title: The heart lives by the One supporting it
subtitle: Raag Maajh · Ang 103
summary: The shabad starts by calling God the breath of life and the support of the mind. It opens further through praise, the peace of Naam, and the journey from restless desire into Saadh Sangat and Guru's vision.
whyItMatters: This shabad speaks to the part of us that secretly tries to hold itself up alone. Stayed with, it turns support from abstraction into something received, and it draws the heart toward company where peace can deepen.
takeaway: Let the mind rest on the One already carrying its life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeea praan prabh maneh adhaaraa ||
lines.translation: God is the Breath of Life of my soul, the Support of my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat jeeveh gun gai apaaraa ||
lines.translation: His devotees live by singing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gun nidhaan a(n)mrit har naamaa har dhiaai dhiaai sukh paiaa jeeau ||1||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is the Treasure of Excellence. Meditating, meditating on the Lord's Name, I have found peace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੋ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਆਵੈ ॥ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manasaa dhaar jo ghar te aavai || saadhasa(n)g janam maran miTaavai ||
lines.translation: One whose heart's desires lead him from his own home to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, shall be rid of the cycle of birth and death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਭੇਟਤ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aas manorath pooran hovai bheTat gur dharasaiaa jeeau ||2||
lines.translation: His hopes and desires are fulfilled, when he gains the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam agochar kichh mit nahee jaanee ||
lines.translation: The limits of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord cannot be known.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhik sidh dhiaaveh giaanee ||
lines.translation: The seekers, the Siddhas, those beings of miraculous spiritual powers, and the spiritual teachers, all meditate on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੁਦੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਚੂਕਾ ਭੋਲਾਵਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: khudhee miTee chookaa bholaavaa gur man hee meh pragaTaiaa jeeau ||3||
lines.translation: Thus, their egos are erased, and their doubts are dispelled. The Guru has enlightened their minds. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadh ma(n)gal kaliaan nidhaanaa || sookh sahaj har naam vakhaanaa ||
lines.translation: I chant the Name of the Lord, the Treasure of bliss, joy, salvation, intuitive peace and poise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: hoi kirapaal suaamee apanaa naau naanak ghar meh aaiaa jeeau ||4||25||32||
lines.translation: When my Lord and Master blessed me with His Mercy, O Nanak, then His Name entered the home of my mind. ||4||25||32||

structure: The shabad starts with support named as intimate and foundational: the Lord as breath and stay.
From there it turns that support into praise and the quieting peace of Naam.
The closing movement rests by drawing restless desire into holy company and the Guru's healing vision.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad starts by calling God the breath of life and the support of the mind. It opens further through praise, the peace of Naam, and the journey from restless desire into Saadh Sangat and Guru's vision.
evidence.turn: From there it turns that support into praise and the quieting peace of Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: This shabad speaks to the part of us that secretly tries to hold itself up alone. Stayed with, it turns support from abstraction into something received, and it draws the heart toward company where peace can deepen. Let the mind rest on the One already carrying its life.

title: The key is handed to the Guru
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 204
summary: The shabad opens with an honest plea for the saint who can show the way to the Lord. It travels through ego's curtain, Maya's sleep, and the hidden substance within, before coming to rest in the Guru holding the key.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person who knows effort alone is not getting them home. Held patiently, it changes spiritual frustration into a truer dependence on the Guru and the company of the holy.
takeaway: Ask for the guidance that can lead you through ego's curtain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee poorabee mahalaa panjavaa
lines.translation: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kin bidh milai gusaiee mere raam rai ||
lines.translation: How may I meet my Master, the King, the Lord of the Universe?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੇਇ ਬਤਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: koiee aaisaa sa(n)t sahaj sukhadhaataa moh maarag dhei bataiee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Is there any Saint, who can bestow such celestial peace, and show me the Way to Him? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar alakh na jaiee lakhiaa vich paRadhaa haumai paiee ||
lines.translation: The Unseen Lord is deep within the self; He cannot be seen; the curtain of egotism intervenes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਭੋ ਜਗੁ ਸੋਇਆ ਇਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: maiaa moh sabho jag soiaa ih bharam kahahu kiau jaiee ||1||
lines.translation: In emotional attachment to Maya, all the world is asleep. Tell me, how can this doubt be dispelled? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਕਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਸਤੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਕਰਤੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekaa sa(n)gat ikat gireh basate mil baat na karate bhaiee ||
lines.translation: The one lives together with the other in the same house, but they do not talk to one another, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਬਸਤੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ ਓਹ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਠਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ek basat bin pa(n)ch dhuhele oh basat agochar Thaiee ||2||
lines.translation: Without the one substance, the five are miserable; that substance is in the unapproachable place. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਤਾਲਾ ਕੁੰਜੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਉਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kaa girahu tin dheeaa taalaa ku(n)jee gur saupaiee ||
lines.translation: And the one whose home it is, has locked it up, and given the key to the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: anik upaav kare nahee paavai bin satigur saranaiee ||3||
lines.translation: You may make all sorts of efforts, but it cannot be obtained, without the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਿਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin ke ba(n)dhan kaaTe satigur tin saadhasa(n)gat liv laiee ||
lines.translation: Those whose bonds have been broken by the True Guru, enshrine love for the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch janaa mil ma(n)gal gaiaa har naanak bhedh na bhaiee ||4||
lines.translation: The self-elect, the self-realized beings, meet together and sing the joyous songs of the Lord. Nanak, there is no difference between them, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere raam rai in bidh milai gusaiee ||
lines.translation: This is how my Sovereign Lord King, the Lord of the Universe, is met;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਠਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੧੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj bhiaa bhram khin meh naaThaa mil jotee jot samaiee ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||1||122||
lines.translation: celestial bliss is attained in an instant, and doubt is dispelled. Meeting Him, my light merges in the Light. ||1||Second Pause||1||122||

structure: The shabad starts with a direct request for the saint who can show the way.
From there it explains why the Lord feels hidden: ego, Maya, and the misery of the five keep the house sealed.
The closing movement rests by placing the key with the Guru and joy with the company of the holy.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad opens with an honest plea for the saint who can show the way to the Lord. It travels through ego's curtain, Maya's sleep, and the hidden substance within, before coming to rest in the Guru holding the key.
evidence.turn: From there it explains why the Lord feels hidden: ego, Maya, and the misery of the five keep the house sealed.
evidence.practicalImplication: This one meets the person who knows effort alone is not getting them home. Held patiently, it changes spiritual frustration into a truer dependence on the Guru and the company of the holy. Ask for the guidance that can lead you through ego's curtain.

title: The Lord's Bani cools what is burning
subtitle: Raag Maajh · Ang 103
summary: The shabad starts by calling the Lord's Bani ambrosial nectar. It travels through repeated hearing, the inner burning extinguished, and the mind cooled in the Guru's presence.
whyItMatters: This speaks to the person whose chest feels hot with grief, agitation, or inner noise. Return to this shabad before reaching for more noise, and Bani stops sounding decorative and starts acting like medicine.
takeaway: Read the Bani again until the inner heat cools.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mirat baanee har har teree ||
lines.translation: The Word of Your Bani, Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun sun hovai param gat meree ||
lines.translation: Hearing it again and again, I am elevated to the supreme heights.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੂਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jalan bujhee seetal hoi manooaa satigur kaa dharasan paae jeeau ||1||
lines.translation: The burning within me has been extinguished, and my mind has been cooled and soothed, by the Blessed Vision of the True Guru. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖੁ ਭਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sookh bhiaa dhukh dhoor paraanaa ||
lines.translation: Happiness is obtained, and sorrow runs far away,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਰਸਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t rasan har naam vakhaanaa ||
lines.translation: when the Saints chant the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰੇ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal neer bhare sar subhar birathaa koi na jaae jeeau ||2||
lines.translation: The sea, the dry land, and the lakes are filled with the Water of the Lord's Name; no place is left empty. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhiaa dhaaree tin sirajanahaare ||
lines.translation: The Creator has showered His Kindness;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeea ja(n)t sagale pratipaare ||
lines.translation: He cherishes and nurtures all beings and creatures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: miharavaan kirapaal dhiaalaa sagale tirapat aghaae jeeau ||3||
lines.translation: He is Merciful, Kind and Compassionate. All are satisfied and fulfilled through Him. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: van tiran tirabhavan keeton hariaa ||
lines.translation: The woods, the meadows and the three worlds are rendered green.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣਹਾਰਿ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: karanahaar khin bheetar kariaa ||
lines.translation: The Doer of all did this in an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੈ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naanak tisai araadhe man kee aas pujaae jeeau ||4||23||30||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, Nanak meditates on the One who fulfills the desires of the mind. ||4||23||30||

structure: The shabad starts with Bani as nectar, not ornament.
From there it lets repeated hearing work on the heart instead of merely informing the mind.
The closing movement rests with inner burning extinguished and the mind cooled in the Guru's presence.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad starts by calling the Lord's Bani ambrosial nectar. It travels through repeated hearing, the inner burning extinguished, and the mind cooled in the Guru's presence.
evidence.turn: From there it lets repeated hearing work on the heart instead of merely informing the mind.
evidence.practicalImplication: This speaks to the person whose chest feels hot with grief, agitation, or inner noise. Return to this shabad before reaching for more noise, and Bani stops sounding decorative and starts acting like medicine. Read the Bani again until the inner heat cools.

title: The powerful cannot do your inner work
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 238
summary: The shabad begins by fastening the mind to the Lord and declaring that nothing else is of real use. It then strips glamour from worldly greatness, lifts up the humble servant, and ends in work done for the Lord alone.
whyItMatters: This speaks to the person drawn to influence, status, and impressive company as if they could save the heart. Held firmly, it redirects admiration away from power and toward devotion, humility, and labor for the Lord.
takeaway: Remember this: seek the humble servant, not the world's impressive names.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa panjavaa ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਤ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har siau jurai ta sabh ko meet ||
lines.translation: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, then everyone is his friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਤ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har siau jurai ta nihachal cheet ||
lines.translation: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, then his consciousness is steady.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕਾੜੑਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har siau jurai na viaapai kaaR(h)aa ||
lines.translation: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, he is not afflicted by worries.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਤ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har siau jurai ta hoi nisataaraa ||1||
lines.translation: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, he is emancipated. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: re man mere too(n) har siau jor ||
lines.translation: O my mind, unite yourself with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਜਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaj tuhaarai naahee hor ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Nothing else is of any use to you. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਜੋ ਦੁਨੀਆਦਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadde vadde jo dhuneeaadhaar ||
lines.translation: The great and powerful people of the world

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਜਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaahoo kaaj naahee gaavaar ||
lines.translation: are of no use, you fool!

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲੁ ਸੁਣਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa dhaas neech kul suneh ||
lines.translation: The Lord's slave may be born of humble origins,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਧਰਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tis kai sa(n)g khin meh udhareh ||2||
lines.translation: but in his company, you shall be saved in an instant. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਜਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: koT majan jaa kai sun naam ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is equal to millions of cleansing baths.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: koT poojaa jaa kai hai dhiaan ||
lines.translation: Meditating on it is equal to millions of worship ceremonies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: koT pu(n)n sun har kee baanee ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Word of the Lord's Bani is equal to giving millions in alms.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਫਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: koT falaa gur te bidh jaanee ||3||
lines.translation: To know the way, through the Guru, is equal to millions of rewards. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਚੇਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: man apune meh fir fir chet ||
lines.translation: Within your mind, over and over again, think of Him,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਹੇਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: binas jaeh maiaa ke het ||
lines.translation: and your love of Maya shall depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har abinaasee tumarai sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: The Imperishable Lord is always with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਚੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: man mere rach raam kai ra(n)g ||4||
lines.translation: O my mind, immerse yourself in the Love of the Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਭ ਭੂਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai kaam utarai sabh bhookh ||
lines.translation: Working for Him, all hunger departs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਦੂਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai kaam na joheh dhoot ||
lines.translation: Working for Him, the Messenger of Death will not be watching you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਗਮਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai kaam teraa vadd gamar ||
lines.translation: Working for Him, you shall obtain glorious greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਮਰੁ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai kaam hoveh too(n) amar ||5||
lines.translation: Working for Him, you shall become immortal. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਕਉ ਨਹੀ ਡਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa ke chaakar kau nahee ddaan ||
lines.translation: His servant does not suffer punishment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਕਉ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa ke chaakar kau nahee baan ||
lines.translation: His servant suffers no loss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦਫਤਰਿ ਪੁਛੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai dhafatar puchhai na lekhaa ||
lines.translation: In His Court, His servant does not have to answer for his account.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਿਸੇਖਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: taa kee chaakaree karahu bisekhaa ||6||
lines.translation: So serve Him with distinction. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਊਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai uoon naahee kaahoo baat ||
lines.translation: He is not lacking in anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਨੇਕਹਿ ਭਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekeh aap anekeh bhaat ||
lines.translation: He Himself is One, although He appears in so many forms.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kee dhirasaT hoi sadhaa nihaal ||
lines.translation: By His Glance of Grace, you shall be happy forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਘਾਲ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: man mere kar taa kee ghaal ||7||
lines.translation: So work for Him, O my mind. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੂੜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa ko chatur naahee ko mooRaa ||
lines.translation: No one is clever, and no one is foolish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa ko heen naahee ko sooraa ||
lines.translation: No one is weak, and no one is a hero.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit ko laiaa tit hee laagaa ||
lines.translation: As the Lord attaches someone, so is he attached.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੮॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: so sevak naanak jis bhaagaa ||8||6||
lines.translation: He alone is the Lord's servant, O Nanak, who is so blessed. ||8||6||

structure: The shabad starts with a blunt claim: only union with the Lord steadies and saves.
From there it dismisses worldly greatness and exalts the saving force of humble company and the Guru's way.
The closing movement rests by calling the mind to work for the Lord instead of for rank, hunger, or image.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad begins by fastening the mind to the Lord and declaring that nothing else is of real use. It then strips glamour from worldly greatness, lifts up the humble servant, and ends in work done for the Lord alone.
evidence.turn: From there it dismisses worldly greatness and exalts the saving force of humble company and the Guru's way.
evidence.practicalImplication: This speaks to the person drawn to influence, status, and impressive company as if they could save the heart. Held firmly, it redirects admiration away from power and toward devotion, humility, and labor for the Lord. Remember this: seek the humble servant, not the world's impressive names.

title: The Shabad clears the double mind
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 35
summary: The shabad opens with contemplation of the Guru's word and the reverence it produces. It moves into abiding in true company, casting off duality, and ending in speech and mind made truthful by love.
whyItMatters: This is for anyone who keeps reopening certainty until it turns cloudy. Taken faithfully, it gives doubt a cleaner answer than endless thought: remain with the Shabad until the split mind thins.
takeaway: Stay with the Shabad until duality loses its grip.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਭਉ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaa bhau tin paion jin gur kaa sabadh beechaar ||
lines.translation: Those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad are filled with the Fear of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gatee sadhaa mil rahe sache ke gun saar ||
lines.translation: They remain forever merged with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; they dwell upon the Glories of the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhubidhaa mail chukaieean har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: They cast off the filth of their mental duality, and they keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sachee baanee sach man sache naal piaar ||1||
lines.translation: True is their speech, and true are their minds. They are in love with the True One. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere haumai mail bhar naal ||
lines.translation: O my mind, you are filled with the filth of egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har niramal sadhaa sohanaa sabadh savaaranahaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Immaculate Lord is eternally Beautiful. We are adorned with the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabadh man mohiaa prabh aape le milai ||
lines.translation: God joins to Himself those whose minds are fascinated with the True Word of His Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadhin naame ratiaa jotee jot samai ||
lines.translation: Night and day, they are attuned to the Naam, and their light is absorbed into the Light.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਹੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਦਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jotee hoo prabh jaapadhaa bin satagur boojh na pai ||
lines.translation: Through His Light, God is revealed. Without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa satagur bheTiaa tin aai ||2||
lines.translation: The True Guru comes to meet those who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਡੁਮਣੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin naavai sabh ddumanee dhoojai bhai khuaai ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, all are miserable. In the love of duality, they are ruined.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਦੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis bin ghaRee na jeevadhee dhukhee rain vihai ||
lines.translation: Without Him, I cannot survive even for an instant, and my life-night passes in anguish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bharam bhulaanaa a(n)dhulaa fir fir aavai jai ||
lines.translation: Wandering in doubt, the spiritually blind come and go in reincarnation, over and over again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: nadhar kare prabh aapanee aape le milai ||3||
lines.translation: When God Himself bestows His Glance of Grace, He blends us into Himself. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਣਦਾ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਕਿਉ ਮੁਕਰਿ ਪਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh sunadhaa vekhadhaa kiau mukar piaa jai ||
lines.translation: He hears and sees everything. How can anyone deny Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੋ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਪਾਪੇ ਪਚਹਿ ਪਚਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paapo paap kamaavadhe paape pacheh pachai ||
lines.translation: Those who sin again and again, shall rot and die in sin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: so prabh nadhar na aaviee manmukh boojh na pai ||
lines.translation: God's Glance of Grace does not come to them; those self-willed manmukhs do not obtain understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਾਲੇ ਸੋਈ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੫੬॥
lines.transliteration: jis vekhaale soiee vekhai naanak gurmukh pai ||4||23||56||
lines.translation: They alone see the Lord, unto whom He reveals Himself. O Nanak, the Gurmukhs find Him. ||4||23||56||

structure: The shabad starts with the Guru's word filling the heart with reverent seriousness.
From there it keeps the soul in true company until mental duality starts to fall away.
The closing movement rests in truthful speech and mind because love has replaced inner division.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad opens with contemplation of the Guru's word and the reverence it produces. It moves into abiding in true company, casting off duality, and ending in speech and mind made truthful by love.
evidence.turn: From there it keeps the soul in true company until mental duality starts to fall away.
evidence.practicalImplication: This is for anyone who keeps reopening certainty until it turns cloudy. Taken faithfully, it gives doubt a cleaner answer than endless thought: remain with the Shabad until the split mind thins. Stay with the Shabad until duality loses its grip.

title: The soul was never yours to keep
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 188
summary: The shabad begins by unsettling possessive grief — relations are named, but ownership is false. It moves through Hukam, shared dust and breath, and ends when the Guru opens the shutters of doubt.
whyItMatters: This speaks to the person overwhelmed by loss, panic, or the cry of mine. Taken seriously, it does not belittle sorrow, but it stops grief from turning into possession.
takeaway: Let grief answer to Hukam instead of ownership.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa panjavaa ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਬਾਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaa kee maiee kaa ko baap ||
lines.translation: Whose mother is this? Whose father is this?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਧਾਰੀਕ ਝੂਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਕ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam dhaareek jhooThe sabh saak ||1||
lines.translation: They are relatives in name only- they are all false. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਮੂਰਖ ਭਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaahe kau moorakh bhakhalaiaa ||
lines.translation: Why are you screaming and shouting, you fool?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil sa(n)jog hukam too(n) aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By good destiny and the Lord's Order, you have come into the world. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekaa maaTee ekaa jot ||
lines.translation: There is the one dust, the one light,

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਉਨੁ ਰੋਤਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: eko pavan kahaa kaun rot ||2||
lines.translation: the one praanic wind. Why are you crying? For whom do you cry? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa meraa kar bilalaahee ||
lines.translation: People weep and cry out, ""Mine, mine!""

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: maranahaar ih jeearaa naahee ||3||
lines.translation: This soul is not perishable. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਲੇ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak gur khole kapaaT ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has opened my shutters;

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਥਾਟ ॥੪॥੪੩॥੧੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: mukat bhe binase bhram thaaT ||4||43||112||
lines.translation: I am liberated, and my doubts have been dispelled. ||4||43||112||

structure: The shabad begins by exposing how quickly the mind tries to own what was never its possession.
From there it breaks the illusion further through one dust, one light, and one breath moving through all.
The closing movement rests with the Guru opening the inner shutters until doubt gives way to release.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad begins by unsettling possessive grief — relations are named, but ownership is false. It moves through Hukam, shared dust and breath, and ends when the Guru opens the shutters of doubt.
evidence.turn: From there it breaks the illusion further through one dust, one light, and one breath moving through all.
evidence.practicalImplication: This speaks to the person overwhelmed by loss, panic, or the cry of mine. Taken seriously, it does not belittle sorrow, but it stops grief from turning into possession. Let grief answer to Hukam instead of ownership.

title: The split mind becomes one through surrender
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 222
summary: The shabad starts by naming the problem sharply — the mind is ruled by evil intellect and duality. It keeps tracing that divided life through Maya, craving, and anxious loss until peace appears only through surrender, Shabad, and Naam.
whyItMatters: This shabad speaks to the part of us that is mentally scattered, morally divided, and unable to stay steady. Kept close, it gives a truer diagnosis than busyness does and a truer treatment than willpower alone can.
takeaway: The mind's problem is divided allegiance, and the Guru teaches surrender into the One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa pehilaa ||
lines.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa man marai na kaaraj hoi ||
lines.translation: The mind does not die, so the job is not accomplished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਦੂਤਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man vas dhootaa dhuramat dhoi ||
lines.translation: The mind is under the power of the demons of evil intellect and duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਇਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: man maanai gur te ik hoi ||1||
lines.translation: But when the mind surrenders, through the Guru, it becomes one. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਰਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਹ ਵਸਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: niragun raam guneh vas hoi ||
lines.translation: The Lord is without attributes; the attributes of virtue are under His control.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap nivaar beechaare soi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: One who eliminates selfishness contemplates Him. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਭੂਲੋ ਬਹੁ ਚਿਤੈ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man bhoolo bahu chitai vikaar ||
lines.translation: The deluded mind thinks of all sorts of corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਭੂਲੋ ਸਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man bhoolo sir aavai bhaar ||
lines.translation: When the mind is deluded, the load of wickedness falls on the head.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: man maanai har eka(n)kaar ||2||
lines.translation: But when the mind surrenders to the Lord, it realizes the One and Only Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਭੂਲੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man bhoolo maiaa ghar jai ||
lines.translation: The deluded mind enters the house of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਬਿਰੂਧਉ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਠਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam biroodhau rahai na Thai ||
lines.translation: Engrossed in sexual desire, it does not remain steady.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har bhaj praanee rasan rasai ||3||
lines.translation: O mortal, lovingly vibrate the Lord's Name with your tongue. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੈਵਰ ਹੈਵਰ ਕੰਚਨ ਸੁਤ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaivar haivar ka(n)chan sut naaree ||
lines.translation: Elephants, horses, gold, children and spouses

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਪਿੜ ਚਾਲੈ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu chi(n)taa piR chaalai haaree ||
lines.translation: in the anxious affairs of all these, people lose the game and depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੂਐ ਖੇਲਣੁ ਕਾਚੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jooaai khelan kaachee saaree ||4||
lines.translation: In the game of chess, their pieces do not reach their destination. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਪਉ ਸੰਚੀ ਭਏ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)pau sa(n)chee bhe vikaar ||
lines.translation: They gather wealth, but only evil comes from it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਕ ਉਭੇ ਦਰਵਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: harakh sok ubhe dharavaar ||
lines.translation: Pleasure and pain stand in the doorway.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sukh sahaje jap ridhai muraar ||5||
lines.translation: Intuitive peace comes by meditating on the Lord, within the heart. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadhar kare taa mel milaae ||
lines.translation: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then He unites us in His Union.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun sa(n)greh aaugan sabadh jalaae ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, merits are gathered in, and demerits are burned away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam padhaarath paae ||6||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai sabh dhookh nivaas ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, all live in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: manmukh mooR maiaa chit vaas ||
lines.translation: The consciousness of the foolish, self-willed manmukh is the dwelling place of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸੁ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: gurmukh giaan dhur karam likhiaas ||7||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom, according to pre-ordained destiny. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man cha(n)chal dhaavat fun dhaavai ||
lines.translation: The fickle mind continuously runs after fleeting things.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸੂਚੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saache sooche mail na bhaavai ||
lines.translation: The Pure True Lord is not pleased by filth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh har gun gaavai ||8||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||8||3||

structure: The shabad begins by saying the job is unfinished as long as the mind remains alive to duality.
From there it follows that split mind into Maya, corruption, anxiety, and unending motion.
The closing movement rests with grace, Shabad, and Naam gathering merits and drawing the mind back toward unity.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad starts by naming the problem sharply — the mind is ruled by evil intellect and duality. It keeps tracing that divided life through Maya, craving, and anxious loss until peace appears only through surrender, Shabad, and Naam.
evidence.turn: From there it follows that split mind into Maya, corruption, anxiety, and unending motion.
evidence.practicalImplication: This shabad speaks to the part of us that is mentally scattered, morally divided, and unable to stay steady. Kept close, it gives a truer diagnosis than busyness does and a truer treatment than willpower alone can. The mind's problem is divided allegiance, and the Guru teaches surrender into the One.

title: The world asks for peace and forgets Naam
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 222
summary: The shabad starts by saying egotism cannot produce peace. It broadens into the world's false bargaining for comfort, then returns again and again to service, Shabad, Naam, and the Lord's Will.
whyItMatters: This shabad speaks to the part of us that is exhausted by self-will but still expecting it to work. Kept close, it exposes the fraud of ego and turns the heart toward Naam as the only lasting peace.
takeaway: Ego cannot make peace; Naam and service can.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa pehilaa ||
lines.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਨਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai karatiaa neh sukh hoi ||
lines.translation: Acting in egotism, peace is not obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮਤਿ ਝੂਠੀ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manmat jhooThee sachaa soi ||
lines.translation: The intellect of the mind is false; only the Lord is True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਗੂਤੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਦੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal bigoote bhaavai dhoi ||
lines.translation: All who love duality are ruined.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: so kamaavai dhur likhiaa hoi ||1||
lines.translation: People act as they are pre-ordained. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਜਗੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜੂਆਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaisaa jag dhekhiaa jooaaree ||
lines.translation: I have seen the world to be such a gambler;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh sukh maagai naam bisaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: all beg for peace, but they forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਤਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: adhisaT dhisai taa kahiaa jai ||
lines.translation: If the Unseen Lord could be seen, then He could be described.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਕਹਣਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin dhekhe kahanaa birathaa jai ||
lines.translation: Without seeing Him, all descriptions are useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurmukh dheesai sahaj subhai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh sees Him with intuitive ease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sevaa surat ek liv lai ||2||
lines.translation: So serve the One Lord, with loving awareness. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਂਗਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਗਲ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh maa(n)gat dhukh aagal hoi ||
lines.translation: People beg for peace, but they receive severe pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal vikaaree haar paroi ||
lines.translation: They are all weaving a wreath of corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ ਝੂਠੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek binaa jhooThe mukat na hoi ||
lines.translation: You are false - without the One, there is no liberation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kar kar karataa dhekhai soi ||3||
lines.translation: The Creator created the creation, and He watches over it. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: tirasanaa agan sabadh bujhaae ||
lines.translation: The fire of desire is quenched by the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhoojaa bharam sahaj subhaae ||
lines.translation: Duality and doubt are automatically eliminated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurmatee naam ridhai vasaae ||
lines.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Naam abides in the heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: saachee baanee har gun gaae ||4||
lines.translation: Through the True Word of His Bani, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan meh saacho gurmukh bhaau ||
lines.translation: The True Lord abides within the body of that Gurmukh who enshrines love for Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਜ ਠਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa naahee nij Thaau ||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, none obtain their own place.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਾਇਣ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: prem parain preetam raau ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Lord King is dedicated to love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: nadhar kare taa boojhai naau ||5||
lines.translation: If He bestows His Glance of Grace, then we realize His Name. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maiaa moh sarab ja(n)jaalaa ||
lines.translation: Emotional attachment to Maya is total entanglement.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਕੁਛਿਤ ਬਿਕਰਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: manmukh kucheel kuchhit bikaraalaa ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh is filthy, cursed and dreadful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਚੂਕੈ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seve chookai ja(n)jaalaa ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, these entanglements are ended.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਲਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mirat naam sadhaa sukh naalaa ||6||
lines.translation: In the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, you shall abide in lasting peace. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurmukh boojhai ek liv laae ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs understand the One Lord, and enshrine love for Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vaasai saach samaae ||
lines.translation: They dwell in the home of their own inner beings, and merge in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ja(n)man maranaa Thaak rahaae ||
lines.translation: The cycle of birth and death is ended.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: poore gur te ieh mat paae ||7||
lines.translation: This understanding is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਕਥਉ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਓਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kathanee kathau na aavai or ||
lines.translation: Speaking the speech, there is no end to it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਛਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਰੁ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur puchh dhekhiaa naahee dhar hor ||
lines.translation: I have consulted the Guru, and I have seen that there is no other door than His.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਭਾਣੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhukh sukh bhaanai tisai rajai ||
lines.translation: Pain and pleasure reside in the Pleasure of His Will and His Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੮॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak neech kahai liv lai ||8||4||
lines.translation: Nanak, the lowly, says embrace love for the Lord. ||8||4||

structure: The shabad begins by naming egotism and false intellect as the root of unrest.
From there it exposes the world's gamble: begging for peace while forgetting Naam.
The closing movement rests in service, Bani, grace, and the Lord's Will as the place where peace actually stays.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad starts by saying egotism cannot produce peace. It broadens into the world's false bargaining for comfort, then returns again and again to service, Shabad, Naam, and the Lord's Will.
evidence.turn: From there it exposes the world's gamble: begging for peace while forgetting Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: This shabad speaks to the part of us that is exhausted by self-will but still expecting it to work. Kept close, it exposes the fraud of ego and turns the heart toward Naam as the only lasting peace. Ego cannot make peace; Naam and service can.

title: This is not your lasting home
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 256
summary: The pauree begins by stripping this passing world of final status. It teaches that the way to the true dwelling is known through the Guru's Shabad, and that stable belonging is found in the company of the holy rather than in what cannot go with you.
whyItMatters: This one speaks to the person who feels unrooted, easily swayed, or hungry for real belonging. Taken seriously, it loosens attachment to what cannot last and directs the heart toward the company that steadies it.
takeaway: Do not mistake the temporary camp for your true home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਡਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਹ ਡੇਰਾ ਤਹ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ddaddaa dderaa ih nahee jeh dderaa teh jaan ||
lines.translation: DADDA: This is not your true place; you must know where that place really is.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: auaa dderaa kaa sa(n)jamo gur kai sabadh pachhaan ||
lines.translation: You shall come to realize the way to that place, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕਉ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: eiaa dderaa kau sram kar ghaalai ||
lines.translation: This place, here, is established by hard work,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਤਸੂ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa tasoo nahee sa(n)g chaalai ||
lines.translation: but not one iota of this shall go there with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: auaa dderaa kee so mit jaanai ||
lines.translation: The value of that place beyond is known only to those,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau dhirasaT pooran bhagavaanai ||
lines.translation: upon whom the Perfect Lord God casts His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਡੇਰਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dderaa nihachal sach saadhasa(n)g paiaa ||
lines.translation: That permanent and true place is obtained in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਹ ਡੋਲਾਇਆ ॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak te jan neh ddolaiaa ||29||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those humble beings do not waver or wander. ||29||

structure: The shabad says plainly that this visible place is not the soul's final dwelling.
From there it teaches that the way there is recognized through the Guru's Shabad, not through possession or effort alone.
It finally locates true stability in Saadh Sangat, where the heart stops wavering.

evidence.coreClaim: The pauree begins by stripping this passing world of final status. It teaches that the way to the true dwelling is known through the Guru's Shabad, and that stable belonging is found in the company of the holy rather than in what cannot go with you.
evidence.turn: From there it teaches that the way there is recognized through the Guru's Shabad, not through possession or effort alone.
evidence.practicalImplication: This one speaks to the person who feels unrooted, easily swayed, or hungry for real belonging. Taken seriously, it loosens attachment to what cannot last and directs the heart toward the company that steadies it. Do not mistake the temporary camp for your true home.

title: Those who serve the True Guru receive the Name
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 86
summary: The shabad starts with service to the True Guru and refuses to separate understanding from obedience. As it deepens, complaint quiets, ego is consumed, and liberation appears as love for the Beloved.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person who keeps circling the issue but cannot settle the mind. Stayed with honestly, it changes reflection itself: insight stops being private theory and becomes something received through service, purity, and love.
takeaway: Keep this in front of you: serve the Guru until complaint thins and love for the Beloved rises.

lines.transliteration: mahalaa teejaa ||
lines.translation: Third Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee satigur seviaa tinee naau paiaa boojhahu kar beechaar ||
lines.translation: Those who serve the True Guru obtain the Name. Reflect on this and understand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadhaa saa(n)t sukh man vasai chookai kook pukaar ||
lines.translation: Eternal peace and joy abide in their minds; they abandon their cries and complaints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਨੋ ਆਪੁ ਖਾਇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapai no aap khai man niramal hovai gur sabadhee veechaar ||
lines.translation: Their identity consumes their identical identity, and their minds become pure by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sabadh rate se mukat hai har jeeau het piaar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, attuned to the Shabad, they are liberated. They love their Beloved Lord. ||2||

structure: The shabad begins by joining service, Naam, and understanding in one movement.
From there it shows the fruit of that service: peace settles in, complaint recedes, and self-importance is eaten away.
The closing movement rests with liberation as attachment to the Shabad and love for the Lord.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad starts with service to the True Guru and refuses to separate understanding from obedience. As it deepens, complaint quiets, ego is consumed, and liberation appears as love for the Beloved.
evidence.turn: From there it shows the fruit of that service: peace settles in, complaint recedes, and self-importance is eaten away.
evidence.practicalImplication: This one meets the person who keeps circling the issue but cannot settle the mind. Stayed with honestly, it changes reflection itself: insight stops being private theory and becomes something received through service, purity, and love. Keep this in front of you: serve the Guru until complaint thins and love for the Beloved rises.

title: Truth before beginning, truth through time
subtitle: Jap · Ang 1
summary: The shabad opens by naming Truth before time, mood, or human history. It strips away silence, accumulation, and cleverness, before coming to rest in the question of how falsehood breaks: by walking in Hukam.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person swollen with urgency, cleverness, or spiritual self-effort. Kept close, it changes scale: your fear stops posing as ultimate, and you begin learning how to live under what is already true.
takeaway: Truth is not won by pressure or wit, but by walking in Hukam.

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. The Name Is Truth. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace ~

lines.gurmukhi: ॥ ਜਪੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: || jap ||
lines.translation: Name of the Composition, "Jup". Chant And Meditate:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਸਚੁ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਚੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aadh sach jugaadh sach ||
lines.translation: True In The Primal Beginning. True Throughout The Ages.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਸੀ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hai bhee sach naanak hosee bhee sach ||1||
lines.translation: True Here And Now. O Nanak, Forever And Ever True. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਚੈ ਸੋਚਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸੋਚੀ ਲਖ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sochai soch na hoviee je sochee lakh vaar ||
lines.translation: Even if one bathes hundreds of thousands of times, the mind does not become cleansed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੁਪੈ ਚੁਪ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਲਾਇ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: chupai chup na hoviee je lai rahaa liv taar ||
lines.translation: By remaining silent, inner silence is not obtained, even by remaining lovingly absorbed deep within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੀ ਜੇ ਬੰਨਾ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਭਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhukhiaa bhukh na utaree je ba(n)naa pureeaa bhaar ||
lines.translation: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased, even by piling up loads of worldly goods.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਤ ਇਕ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahas siaanapaa lakh hoh ta ik na chalai naal ||
lines.translation: Hundreds of thousands of clever tricks, but not even one of them will go along with you in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਵ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਹੋਈਐ ਕਿਵ ਕੂੜੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਪਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiv sachiaaraa hoieeaai kiv kooRai tuTai paal ||
lines.translation: So how can you become truthful? And how can the veil of falsehood be torn away?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਚਲਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hukam rajaiee chalanaa naanak likhiaa naal ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, it is written that you shall obey the Hukam of His Command, and walk in the Way of His Will. ||1||

structure: The shabad opens above history itself: Truth before beginning, through the ages, and not dependent on your recognition.
From there it refuses the usual escapes, because silence, accumulation, and cleverness do not tear falsehood open.
The closing movement rests in a single turn: become truthful by walking in Hukam, not by mastering the illusion of control.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad opens by naming Truth before time, mood, or human history. It strips away silence, accumulation, and cleverness, before coming to rest in the question of how falsehood breaks: by walking in Hukam.
evidence.turn: From there it refuses the usual escapes, because silence, accumulation, and cleverness do not tear falsehood open.
evidence.practicalImplication: This one meets the person swollen with urgency, cleverness, or spiritual self-effort. Kept close, it changes scale: your fear stops posing as ultimate, and you begin learning how to live under what is already true. Truth is not won by pressure or wit, but by walking in Hukam.

title: Truth gives the heart a steadier worth
subtitle: Raag Maajh · Ang 119
summary: The shabad begins with those who please the Lord being linked to Truth. It grows into praise, sacrifice to such people, and the state of being absorbed into the Truest of the True.
whyItMatters: This speaks to the person borrowing dignity from response, success, or praise. Read this shabad when approval starts naming your value, and it will return worth to Truth instead of the room's reaction.
takeaway: Keep this in front of you: let Truth, not applause, give the heart its place.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: se sach laage jo tudh bhaae ||
lines.translation: Those who please You are linked to the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadhaa sach seveh sahaj subhaae ||
lines.translation: They serve the True One forever, with intuitive ease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabadh sachaa saalaahee sachai mel milaavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: Through the True Word of the Shabad, they praise the True One, and they merge in the merging of Truth. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree sach saalaahaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who praise the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach dhiaain se sach raate sache sach samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on the True One are attuned to Truth; they are absorbed into the Truest of the True. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeh dhekhaa sach sabhanee thaiee ||
lines.translation: The True One is everywhere, wherever I look.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadhee ma(n)n vasaiee ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I enshrine Him in my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tan sachaa rasanaa sach raatee sach sun aakh vakhaananiaa ||2||
lines.translation: True are the bodies of those whose tongues are attuned to Truth. They hear the Truth, and speak it with their mouths. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: manasaa maar sach samaanee ||
lines.translation: Subduing their desires, they merge with the True One;

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਡੀਠੀ ਸਭ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ein man ddeeThee sabh aavan jaanee ||
lines.translation: they see in their minds that everyone comes and goes in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seve sadhaa man nihachal nij ghar vaasaa paavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, they become stable forever, and they obtain their dwelling in the home of the self. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabadh ridhai dhikhaiaa ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is seen within one's own heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: maiaa moh sabadh jalaiaa ||
lines.translation: Through the Shabad, I have burned my emotional attachment to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sacho sachaa vekh saalaahee gur sabadhee sach paavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: I gaze upon the Truest of the True, and I praise Him. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I obtain the True One. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sach raate tin sachee liv laagee ||
lines.translation: Those who are attuned to Truth are blessed with the Love of the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam samaaleh se vaddabhaagee ||
lines.translation: Those who praise the Lord's Name are very fortunate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabadh aap milaae satasa(n)gat sach gun gaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: Through the Word of His Shabad, the True One blends with Himself, those who join the True Congregation and sing the Glorious Praises of the True One. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਪੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਲੇਖੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: lekhaa paReeaai je lekhe vich hovai ||
lines.translation: We could read the account of the Lord, if He were in any account.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: oh agam agochar sabadh sudh hovai ||
lines.translation: He is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible; through the Shabad, understanding is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: anadhin sach sabadh saalaahee hor koi na keemat paavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: Night and day, praise the True Word of the Shabad. There is no other way to know His Worth. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paR paR thaake saa(n)t na aaiee ||
lines.translation: People read and recite until they grow weary, but they do not find peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਾਲੇ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tirasanaa jaale sudh na kaiee ||
lines.translation: Consumed by desire, they have no understanding at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਬਿਹਾਝਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: bikh bihaajheh bikh moh piaase kooR bol bikh khaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: They purchase poison, and they are thirsty with their fascination for poison. Telling lies, they eat poison. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadhee eko jaanaa ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I know the One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhoojaa maar man sach samaanaa ||
lines.translation: Subduing my sense of duality, my mind is absorbed into the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੭॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak eko naam varatai man a(n)tar gur parasaadhee paavaniaa ||8||17||18||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the One Name is pervading deep within my mind; by Guru's Grace, I receive it. ||8||17||18||

structure: The shabad starts with the ones pleasing the Lord already linked to Truth.
From there it shows praise and service growing naturally from that alignment.
The closing movement rests where the heart is absorbed into the Truest of the True instead of applause.

title: Truth is meant to occupy the whole life
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 69
summary: The shabad starts by joining service to the True Guru with the cleansing of mind and body. Then it keeps widening truth until it touches food, speech, company, clothing, and shelter.
whyItMatters: This is for anyone whose devotion still lives in a separate room from the rest of the day. Stay with it when prayer and conduct drift apart; it insists that truth should enter the whole way you live.
takeaway: Let the Guru's truth reach your food, speech, and shelter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seviaai man niramalaa bhe pavit sareer ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate, and the body becomes pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man aana(n)dh sadhaa sukh paiaa bheTiaa gahir ga(n)bheer ||
lines.translation: The mind obtains bliss and eternal peace, meeting with the Deep and Profound Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬੈਸਣਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sachee sa(n)gat baisanaa sach naam man dheer ||1||
lines.translation: Sitting in the Sangat, the True Congregation, the mind is comforted and consoled by the True Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man re satigur sev nisa(n)g ||
lines.translation: O mind, serve the True Guru without hesitation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seviaai har man vasai lagai na mail pata(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, the Lord abides within the mind, and no trace of filth shall attach itself to you. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabadh pat uoopajai sache sachaa naau ||
lines.translation: From the True Word of the Shabad comes honor. True is the Name of the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee haumai maar pachhaaniaa hau tin balihaarai jaau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who conquer their ego and recognize the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: manmukh sach na jaananee tin Thaur na katahoo thaau ||2||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the True One; they find no shelter, and no place of rest anywhere. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach khaanaa sach painanaa sache hee vich vaas ||
lines.translation: Those who take the Truth as their food and the Truth as their clothing, have their home in the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadhaa sachaa saalaahanaa sachai sabadh nivaas ||
lines.translation: They constantly praise the True One, and in the True Word of the Shabad they have their dwelling.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabh aatam raam pachhaaniaa gurmatee nij ghar vaas ||3||
lines.translation: They recognize the Lord, the Supreme Soul in all, and through the Guru's Teachings they dwell in the home of their own inner self. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach vekhan sach bolanaa tan man sachaa hoi ||
lines.translation: They see the Truth, and they speak the Truth; their bodies and minds are True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee saakhee upadhes sach sache sachee soi ||
lines.translation: True are their teachings, and True are their instructions; True are the reputations of the true ones.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿੰਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਚਲੇ ਰੋਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: ji(n)nee sach visaariaa se dhukhe'ee chale roi ||4||
lines.translation: Those who have forgotten the True One are miserable-they depart weeping and wailing. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur jinee na sevio se kit aae sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Those who have not served the True Guru-why did they even bother to come into the world?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਕੂਕ ਨ ਸੁਣੈ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam dhar badhe maare'eh kook na sunai pookaar ||
lines.translation: They are bound and gagged and beaten at Death's door, but no one hears their shrieks and cries.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: birathaa janam gavaiaa mar ja(n)meh vaaro vaar ||5||
lines.translation: They waste their lives uselessly; they die and are reincarnated over and over again. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਲਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: eh jag jalataa dhekh kai bhaj pe satigur saranaa ||
lines.translation: Seeing this world on fire, I rushed to the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sach dhiRaiaa sadhaa sach sa(n)jam rahanaa ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has implanted the Truth within me; I dwell steadfastly in Truth and self-restraint.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sachaa hai bohithaa sabadhe bhavajal taranaa ||6||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the Boat of Truth; in the Word of the Shabad, we cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh firadhe rahe bin satigur mukat na hoiee ||
lines.translation: People continue wandering through the cycle of 8.4 million incarnations; without the True Guru, liberation is not obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paR paR pa(n)ddit monee thake dhoojai bhai pat khoiee ||
lines.translation: Reading and studying, the Pandits and the silent sages have grown weary, but attached to the love of duality, they have lost their honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sabadh sunaiaa bin sache avar na koiee ||7||
lines.translation: The True Guru teaches the Word of the Shabad; without the True One, there is no other at all. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਚੈ ਲਾਏ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ ਨਿਤ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sachai laae se sach lage nit sachee kaar kara(n)n ||
lines.translation: Those who are linked by the True One are linked to Truth. They always act in Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tinaa nij ghar vaasaa paiaa sachai mahal raha(n)n ||
lines.translation: They attain their dwelling in the home of their own inner being, and they abide in the Mansion of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਚੰਨਿ ॥੮॥੧੭॥੮॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagat sukhe'ee sadhaa sachai naam racha(n)n ||8||17||8||25||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the devotees are happy and peaceful forever. They are absorbed in the True Name. ||8||17||8||25||

structure: The shabad starts with service to the Guru cleaning both mind and body.
From there it makes truth the atmosphere of speech, sustenance, company, and dwelling.
The closing movement rests by hurrying to the Guru's sanctuary as the crossing out of a burning world.
