title: What comes to pass is not outside the Doer
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 154
summary: The shabad begins with the blunt fact that past actions cannot be erased. It moves through uncertainty about outcomes and ends in a harder peace: what pleases the Divine comes to pass, and there is no other Doer.
whyItMatters: This shabad speaks to the part of us that is trapped in regret, replay, or bargaining with the past. Stayed with, it does not sentimentalize pain, but it loosens the argument with reality.
takeaway: Regret quiets when the heart returns the moment to Hukam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa pehilaa ||
lines.translation: Gauree, First Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਨਹ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kirat piaa neh meTai koi ||
lines.translation: Past actions cannot be erased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਿਆ ਆਗੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa jaanaa kiaa aagai hoi ||
lines.translation: What do we know of what will happen hereafter?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਹੂਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tis bhaanaa soiee hooaa ||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases Him shall come to pass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ ਵਾਲਾ ਦੂਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: avar na karanai vaalaa dhooaa ||1||
lines.translation: There is no other Doer except Him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਰਮ ਕੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa jaanaa karam kevadd teree dhaat ||
lines.translation: I do not know about karma, or how great Your gifts are.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam dharam tere naam kee jaat ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The karma of actions, the Dharma of righteousness, social class and status, are contained within Your Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਏਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: too evadd dhaataa dhevanahaar ||
lines.translation: You are So Great, O Giver, O Great Giver!

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: toT naahee tudh bhagat bha(n)ddaar ||
lines.translation: The treasure of Your devotional worship is never exhausted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਆ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: keeaa garab na aavai raas ||
lines.translation: One who takes pride in himself shall never be right.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh terai paas ||2||
lines.translation: The soul and body are all at Your disposal. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਹਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: too maar jeevaaleh bakhas milai ||
lines.translation: You kill and rejuvenate. You forgive and merge us into Yourself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੀ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiau bhaavee tiau naam japai ||
lines.translation: As it pleases You, You inspire us to chant Your Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) dhaanaa beenaa saachaa sir merai ||
lines.translation: You are All-knowing, All-seeing and True, O my Supreme Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਭਰੋਸੈ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gurmat dhei bharosai terai ||3||
lines.translation: Please, bless me with the Guru's Teachings; my faith is in You alone. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan meh mail naahee man raataa ||
lines.translation: One whose mind is attuned to the Lord, has no pollution in his body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bachanee sach sabadh pachhaataa ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, the True Shabad is realized.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa taan naam kee vaddiaaiee ||
lines.translation: All Power is Yours, through the greatness of Your Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak rahanaa bhagat saranaiee ||4||10||
lines.translation: Nanak abides in the Sanctuary of Your devotees. ||4||10||

structure: The shabad begins by refusing the fantasy that the past can be edited after the fact.
From there it stays honest about how little the ego knows of what comes next.
The closing movement rests in the hard mercy that there is no other Doer outside the Divine will.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad begins with the blunt fact that past actions cannot be erased. It moves through uncertainty about outcomes and ends in a harder peace: what pleases the Divine comes to pass, and there is no other Doer.
evidence.turn: From there it stays honest about how little the ego knows of what comes next.
evidence.practicalImplication: This shabad speaks to the part of us that is trapped in regret, replay, or bargaining with the past. Stayed with, it does not sentimentalize pain, but it loosens the argument with reality. Regret quiets when the heart returns the moment to Hukam.

title: Receiving under Hukam
subtitle: So Purakh · Ang 11
summary: The shabad starts by placing all becoming, giving, and receiving in the Lord's pleasure. It opens further through separation and reunion, play and service, and ends where the Creator alone is doing all that happens.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person fighting outcomes they did not choose or trying to carry reality by force. Taken steadily, it teaches a cleaner receiving under Hukam and loosens the fist of resistance.
takeaway: Learn to receive under the Lord's pleasure rather than argue with it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਮੈਡਾ ਸਾਂਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) karataa sachiaar maiddaa saa(n)iee ||
lines.translation: You are the True Creator, my Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਥੀਸੀ ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tau bhaavai soiee theesee jo too(n) dheh soiee hau paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases You comes to pass. As You give, so do we receive. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh teree too(n) sabhanee dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: All belong to You, all meditate on you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no kirapaa kareh tin naam ratan paiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who are blessed with Your Mercy obtain the Jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਧਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurmukh laadhaa manmukh gavaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs obtain it, and the self-willed manmukhs lose it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tudh aap vichhoRiaa aap milaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: You Yourself separate them from Yourself, and You Yourself reunite with them again. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) dhareeaau sabh tujh hee maeh ||
lines.translation: You are the River of Life; all are within You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tujh bin dhoojaa koiee naeh ||
lines.translation: There is no one except You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeea ja(n)t sabh teraa khel ||
lines.translation: All living beings are Your playthings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: vijog mil vichhuRiaa sa(n)jogee mel ||2||
lines.translation: The separated ones meet, and by great good fortune, those suffering in separation are reunited once again. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no too jaanaieh soiee jan jaanai ||
lines.translation: They alone understand, whom You inspire to understand;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun sadh hee aakh vakhaanai ||
lines.translation: they continually chant and repeat the Lord's Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin har seviaa tin sukh paiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who serve You find peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje hee har naam samaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: They are intuitively absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: too aape karataa teraa keeaa sabh hoi ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are the Creator. Everything that happens is by Your Doing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh bin dhoojaa avar na koi ||
lines.translation: There is no one except You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: too kar kar vekheh jaaneh soi ||
lines.translation: You created the creation; You behold it and understand it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gurmukh paragaT hoi ||4||2||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, the Lord is revealed through the Gurmukh, the Living Expression of the Guru's Word. ||4||2||

structure: The shabad begins by aligning what happens with what pleases the Lord.
From there it shows that even loss, reunion, play, and service remain within His doing.
The closing movement rests with the Creator as the only true doer and revelation coming through the Gurmukh.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad starts by placing all becoming, giving, and receiving in the Lord's pleasure. It opens further through separation and reunion, play and service, and ends where the Creator alone is doing all that happens.
evidence.turn: From there it shows that even loss, reunion, play, and service remain within His doing.
evidence.practicalImplication: This one meets the person fighting outcomes they did not choose or trying to carry reality by force. Taken steadily, it teaches a cleaner receiving under Hukam and loosens the fist of resistance. Learn to receive under the Lord's pleasure rather than argue with it.

title: What the Beloved does, I accept
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 187
summary: The shabad opens by yielding the argument with what the Beloved does. It moves into single-hearted reliance until even honor itself is handed back to the One who gave it.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person exhausting themselves by resisting the day, the loss, or the unanswered turn. Stayed with, it changes complaint into trust and loosens the fear that acceptance means abandonment.
takeaway: Let the Beloved's way grow dearer than the mind's protest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa panjavaa ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਹਮ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: meet karai soiee ham maanaa ||
lines.translation: Whatever my Friend does, I accept.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੀਤ ਕੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਕੁਸਲ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: meet ke karatab kusal samaanaa ||1||
lines.translation: My Friend's actions are pleasing to me. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਟੇਕ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekaa Tek merai man cheet ||
lines.translation: Within my conscious mind, the One Lord is my only Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kichh karanaa su hamaraa meet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: One who does this is my Friend. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: meet hamaaraa veparavaahaa ||
lines.translation: My Friend is Carefree.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਸਨਾਹਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaa te moh asanaahaa ||2||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I give my love to Him. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: meet hamaaraa a(n)tarajaamee ||
lines.translation: My Friend is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਮਰਥ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: samarath purakh paarabraham suaamee ||3||
lines.translation: He is the All-powerful Being, the Supreme Lord and Master. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਦਾਸੇ ਤੁਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham dhaase tum Thaakur mere ||
lines.translation: I am Your servant; You are my Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੪॥੪੦॥੧੦੯॥
lines.transliteration: maan mahat naanak prabh tere ||4||40||109||
lines.translation: Nanak: my honor and glory are Yours, God. ||4||40||109||

structure: The shabad starts with bare consent: what the Beloved does is received, not argued with.
From there it gathers the heart around one support, naming the Lord as the inner-knower and only true stay.
The closing movement rests in belonging: servant and Master, honor and glory returned to God alone.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad opens by yielding the argument with what the Beloved does. It moves into single-hearted reliance until even honor itself is handed back to the One who gave it.
evidence.turn: From there it gathers the heart around one support, naming the Lord as the inner-knower and only true stay.
evidence.practicalImplication: This one meets the person exhausting themselves by resisting the day, the loss, or the unanswered turn. Stayed with, it changes complaint into trust and loosens the fear that acceptance means abandonment. Let the Beloved's way grow dearer than the mind's protest.

title: When the Shabad takes the mind in hand
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 221
summary: The shabad begins with a startling image — the mind as elephant, the Guru as goad, the Shabad as the mark that disciplines it. It carries the listener through the failure of cleverness and the growth of fearlessness, then settles in daily remembrance of the One already pervading everything.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person whose mind is strong, clever, and difficult to govern. Taken steadily, it changes what authority feels like: wit, image, and force stop leading, and the Guru's word takes the mind in hand.
takeaway: Let the Guru's Shabad govern the mind before cleverness does.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa pehilaa ||
lines.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਉਦਿਆਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man ku(n)char kaiaa udhiaanai ||
lines.translation: The mind is an elephant in the forest of the body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਨੈ ॥ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਸੋਭ ਸੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur a(n)kas sach sabadh neesaanai || raaj dhuaarai sobh su maanai ||1||
lines.translation: The Guru is the controlling stick; when the Insignia of the True Shabad is applied, one obtains honor in the Court of God the King. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਨਹ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaturaiee neh cheeniaa jai ||
lines.translation: He cannot be known through clever tricks.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin maare kiau keemat pai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without subduing the mind, how can His value be estimated? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਲੇਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar meh a(n)mrit tasakar leiee ||
lines.translation: In the house of the self is the Ambrosial Nectar, which is being stolen by the thieves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੰਨਾਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: na(n)naakaar na koi kareiee ||
lines.translation: No one can say no to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: raakhai aap vaddiaaiee dheiee ||2||
lines.translation: He Himself protects us, and blesses us with greatness. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਲ ਅਨੀਲ ਅਗਨਿ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: neel aneel agan ik Thaiee ||
lines.translation: There are billions, countless billions of fires of desire at the seat of the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਨਿਵਰੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal nivaree gur boojh bujhaiee ||
lines.translation: They are extinguished only with the water of understanding, imparted by the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਦੇ ਲੀਆ ਰਹਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: man dhe leeaa rahas gun gaiee ||3||
lines.translation: Offering my mind, I have attained it, and I joyfully sing His Glorious Praises. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਤੈਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaisaa ghar baahar so taisaa ||
lines.translation: Just as He is within the home of the self, so is He beyond.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੈਸਿ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਆਖਉ ਕੈਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bais gufaa meh aakhau kaisaa ||
lines.translation: But how can I describe Him, sitting in a cave?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰਿ ਡੂਗਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਐਸਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: saagar ddoogar nirabhau aaisaa ||4||
lines.translation: The Fearless Lord is in the oceans, just as He is in the mountains. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਕਹੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਉਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mooe kau kahu maare kaun ||
lines.translation: Tell me, who can kill someone who is already dead?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਡਰੇ ਕਉ ਕੈਸਾ ਡਰੁ ਕਵਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: niddare kau kaisaa ddar kavan ||
lines.translation: What does he fear? Who can frighten the fearless one?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੈ ਤੀਨੇ ਭਉਨ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sabadh pachhaanai teene bhaun ||5||
lines.translation: He recognizes the Word of the Shabad, throughout the three worlds. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਵਖਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kahiaa tin kahan vakhaaniaa ||
lines.translation: One who speaks, merely describes speech.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin boojhiaa tin sahaj pachhaaniaa ||
lines.translation: But one who understands, intuitively realizes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: dhekh beechaar meraa man maaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: Seeing and reflecting upon it, my mind surrenders. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸੂਰਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਇਕ ਨਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: keerat soorat mukat ik naiee ||
lines.translation: Praise, beauty and liberation are in the One Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਹੀ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tahee nira(n)jan rahiaa samaiee ||
lines.translation: In it, the Immaculate Lord is permeating and pervading.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਿਜ ਠਾਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: nij ghar biaap rahiaa nij Thaiee ||7||
lines.translation: He dwells in the home of the self, and in His own sublime place. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ausatat kareh kete mun preet ||
lines.translation: The many silent sages lovingly praise Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੂਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man soochai saachu su cheet ||
lines.translation: Their bodies and minds are purified, as they enshrine the True Lord in their consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤਿ ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har bhaj neetaa neet ||8||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meditate on the Lord, each and every day. ||8||2||

structure: The shabad starts with restraint, not self-display: the mind needs the Guru's goad and the Shabad's mark.
From there it strips away cleverness and fear, teaching that freedom comes when the mind is no longer trying to rule itself.
The closing movement rests in daily remembrance of the Lord who already pervades the whole field.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad begins with a startling image — the mind as elephant, the Guru as goad, the Shabad as the mark that disciplines it. It carries the listener through the failure of cleverness and the growth of fearlessness, then settles in daily remembrance of the One already pervading everything.
evidence.turn: From there it strips away cleverness and fear, teaching that freedom comes when the mind is no longer trying to rule itself.
evidence.practicalImplication: This one meets the person whose mind is strong, clever, and difficult to govern. Taken steadily, it changes what authority feels like: wit, image, and force stop leading, and the Guru's word takes the mind in hand. Let the Guru's Shabad govern the mind before cleverness does.

title: Where praise makes death keep its distance
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 256
summary: This shabad opens inside the place where the Holy keep singing the Lord's praises. It turns the heart toward a sanctuary even fear and death do not rule.
whyItMatters: This matters when speech has turned sharp, anxious, or spiritually thin. The shabad shows that praise changes the whole atmosphere a life is spoken inside.
takeaway: Keep company with praise until fear stops ruling the room.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Shalok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeh saadhoo gobidh bhajan keeratan naanak neet ||
lines.translation: Where the Holy people constantly vibrate the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, O Nanak

lines.gurmukhi: ਣਾ ਹਉ ਣਾ ਤੂੰ ਣਹ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਅਹੁ ਦੂਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naa hau naa too(n) neh chhuTeh nikaT na jaieeahu dhoot ||1||
lines.translation: - the Righteous Judge says, ""Do not approach that place, O Messenger of Death, or else neither you nor I shall escape!""||1||

structure: The shabad begins by placing the seeker inside a living atmosphere of kirtan.
From there it shows that holy speech becomes protection, not ornament.
The closing movement rests by depicting a place even death is told not to approach.

evidence.coreClaim: This shabad opens inside the place where the Holy keep singing the Lord's praises. It turns the heart toward a sanctuary even fear and death do not rule.
evidence.turn: From there it shows that holy speech becomes protection, not ornament.
evidence.practicalImplication: This matters when speech has turned sharp, anxious, or spiritually thin. The shabad shows that praise changes the whole atmosphere a life is spoken inside. Keep company with praise until fear stops ruling the room.

title: Where saving company interrupts judgment
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 256
summary: The shabad begins with the fear of inescapable judgment. It directs the heart toward the saving nearness of Saadh Sangat and remembrance.
whyItMatters: This matters for anyone who feels cut off, exposed, or already condemned. The shabad changes the atmosphere from private doom to shared shelter.
takeaway: Holy company keeps judgment from having the final word.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Shalok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਢਾਹਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਿਨਹਿ ਨ ਘਾਲਿਓ ਬੰਧ ॥
lines.transliteration: ddaahan laage dharam rai kineh na ghaalio ba(n)dh ||
lines.translation: When the Righteous Judge of Dharma begins to destroy someone, no one can place any obstacle in His Way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਨਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ubare jap haree saadhasa(n)g sanaba(n)dh ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who join the Saadh Sangat and meditate on the Lord are saved. ||1||

structure: The shabad begins by naming the helplessness of standing before judgment.
From there it turns toward the company where remembrance is still alive.
The closing movement rests by showing that salvation is received in Sangat, not manufactured alone.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad begins with the fear of inescapable judgment. It directs the heart toward the saving nearness of Saadh Sangat and remembrance.
evidence.turn: From there it turns toward the company where remembrance is still alive.
evidence.practicalImplication: This matters for anyone who feels cut off, exposed, or already condemned. The shabad changes the atmosphere from private doom to shared shelter. Holy company keeps judgment from having the final word.

title: The path is known by labor and generosity
subtitle: Raag Saarang
summary: The piece opens by exposing religious pose without wisdom, labor, or integrity behind it. It comes to a clean test: the one who works for what they eat and gives some away is the one who knows the path.
whyItMatters: This speaks to the person confused by spiritual branding, costume, or authority language. Stayed with honestly, it returns discernment to labor, generosity, and humility.
takeaway: Honest labor and sharing reveal the path better than costume.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
lines.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan vihoonaa gaavai geet ||
lines.translation: The one who lacks spiritual wisdom sings religious songs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੁਖੇ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਘਰੇ ਮਸੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhukhe mulaa(n) ghare maseet ||
lines.translation: The hungry Mullah turns his home into a mosque.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਖਟੂ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਕੰਨ ਪੜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: makhaToo hoi kai ka(n)n paRaae ||
lines.translation: The lazy unemployed has his ears pierced to look like a Yogi.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਕਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਹੋਰੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: fakar kare hor jaat gavaae ||
lines.translation: Someone else becomes a pan-handler, and loses his social status.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ਸਦਾਏ ਮੰਗਣ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur peer sadhaae ma(n)gan jai ||
lines.translation: One who calls himself a guru or a spiritual teacher, while he goes around begging

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਲਗੀਐ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kai mool na lageeaai pai ||
lines.translation: don't ever touch his feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਾਲਿ ਖਾਇ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghaal khai kichh hathahu dhei ||
lines.translation: One who works for what he eats, and gives some of what he has

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਹੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਸੇਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak raahu pachhaaneh sei ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he knows the Path. ||1||

structure: The shabad begins by mocking hollow religious performances that substitute image for wisdom.
From there it refuses reverence toward the guru-figure who begs while claiming status.
The closing movement rests in a simple mark of truth: work honestly, give from your hands, and the path becomes recognizable.

evidence.coreClaim: The piece opens by exposing religious pose without wisdom, labor, or integrity behind it. It comes to a clean test: the one who works for what they eat and gives some away is the one who knows the path.
evidence.turn: From there it refuses reverence toward the guru-figure who begs while claiming status.
evidence.practicalImplication: This speaks to the person confused by spiritual branding, costume, or authority language. Stayed with honestly, it returns discernment to labor, generosity, and humility. Honest labor and sharing reveal the path better than costume.

title: You are family wherever fear tries to exile me
subtitle: Raag Maajh · Ang 103
summary: The shabad begins with intimate naming — Father, Mother, relative, brother. It moves into protection, recognition by grace, and shelter that restores honor where fear had been making the world feel hostile.
whyItMatters: This speaks to the person frightened, exposed, or emotionally orphaned by circumstances. Held tenderly, it makes divine nearness personal enough to change how fear occupies the body.
takeaway: Fear thins when shelter becomes personal again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) meraa pitaa too(n)hai meraa maataa ||
lines.translation: You are my Father, and You are my Mother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) meraa ba(n)dhap too(n) meraa bhraataa ||
lines.translation: You are my Relative, and You are my Brother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਤਾ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਕਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) meraa raakhaa sabhanee thaiee taa bhau kehaa kaaRaa jeeau ||1||
lines.translation: You are my Protector everywhere; why should I feel any fear or anxiety? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumaree kirapaa te tudh pachhaanaa ||
lines.translation: By Your Grace, I recognize You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) meree oT too(n)hai meraa maanaa ||
lines.translation: You are my Shelter, and You are my Honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਅਖਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tujh bin dhoojaa avar na koiee sabh teraa khel akhaaRaa jeeau ||2||
lines.translation: Without You, there is no other; the entire Universe is the Arena of Your Play. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeea ja(n)t sabh tudh upaae ||
lines.translation: You have created all beings and creatures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit jit bhaanaa tit tit laae ||
lines.translation: As it pleases You, You assign tasks to one and all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਸਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh keetaa teraa hovai naahee kichh asaaRaa jeeau ||3||
lines.translation: All things are Your Doing; we can do nothing ourselves. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam dhiaai mahaa sukh paiaa ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Naam, I have found great peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun gai meraa man seetalaiaa ||
lines.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, my mind is cooled and soothed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤਾ ਬਿਖਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai vajee vaadhaiee naanak jitaa bikhaaRaa jeeau ||4||24||31||
lines.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, congratulations are pouring in-Nanak is victorious on the arduous battlefield of life! ||4||24||31||

structure: The shabad begins by naming the Lord as family, not as distant doctrine.
From there it lets protection and fearlessness grow out of that intimacy.
The closing movement rests in grace, shelter, and honor restored where fear had been narrowing the world.

evidence.turn: From there it lets protection and fearlessness grow out of that intimacy.
